title: Quantum-JEPA: Quantum Born Priors for Latent-Action JEPA World Models
title_zh: Quantum-JEPA：用于潜在动作JEPA世界模型的量子玻恩先验

paragraphs.en: A single observation can admit several plausible futures, making uncertainty an essential part of world modelling. However, quantum generative models remain underexplored for this task. We introduce Quantum-JEPA, a latent-action JEPA framework that learns distributions of future representations using a conditional quantum Born prior. Circuit measurements generate binary latent actions, which a shared predictor maps to alternative future representations. We train the quantum prior through the quality and diversity of these predictions using a sampled energy objective. Our model learns distinct continuations on constructed multimodal tasks and captures latent-action correlations that support coordinated multi-agent futures. On D3IL, a benchmark of diverse human demonstrations, our trained models generate multiple obstacle-crossing routes from a common starting point without observed motion. On the controlled tasks, our classical and quantum prior implementations improve prediction validity and distributional fidelity over the evaluated variational baselines. Our quantum priors combine competitive predictive quality with a parameter-efficient sampling structure: they avoid an exponentially sized categorical output layer while supporting correlated latent actions. We further validate finite-shot parameter-shift training, including training with readout noise. Unlike most prior work, which focuses on simulation, we also verify the feasibility of inference with trained priors on a real QPU. These results establish a trainable quantum component for JEPA future prediction and a basis for exploring quantum-enhanced world models at larger scales.
paragraphs.zh: 单一观测可以允许多种合理的未来，因此不确定性成为世界建模中不可或缺的组成部分。 然而，量子生成模型在这一任务上仍未得到充分探索。 我们提出 Quantum-JEPA，这是一个潜在动作 JEPA 框架，利用条件量子玻恩先验学习未来表示的分布。 电路测量生成二值潜在动作，共享预测器将其映射为不同的未来表示。 我们使用采样能量目标，根据这些预测的质量和多样性来训练量子先验。 我们的模型在构建的多模态任务上学习到不同的后续演化，并捕捉支持协调多智能体未来的潜在动作相关性。 在 D3IL 这一包含多样人类演示的基准上，我们训练的模型能够从同一起始点生成多条跨越障碍的路径，而无需观察运动过程。 在受控任务上，我们的经典与量子先验实现相比所评估的变分基线，提升了预测有效性和分布保真度。 我们的量子先验将具有竞争力的预测质量与参数高效的采样结构相结合：它们在支持相关潜在动作的同时，避免了指数级规模的类别输出层。 我们进一步验证了有限测量次数的参数移位训练，包括在读取噪声下进行的训练。 与大多数聚焦于仿真的先前工作不同，我们还在真实 QPU 上验证了使用训练好的先验进行推理的可行性。 这些结果为 JEPA 未来预测确立了一个可训练的量子组件，并为在更大规模上探索量子增强世界模型奠定了基础。

paragraphs.en: LeCun’s blueprint for autonomous machine intelligence assigns unpredictable aspects of a future state to a latent variable within a representation-space world model ( LeCun, 2022 ) . The latent variable can act as an unobserved action: several continuations may be compatible with the same observation, although only one is realized. Modelling this uncertainty requires both a transition mechanism and a way to generate the missing information. Figure 1 illustrates how we connect these two components through quantum-sampled latent actions.
paragraphs.zh: LeCun 的自主机器智能蓝图将未来状态中不可预测的方面归因于表征空间世界模型中的一个潜变量（LeCun, 2022）。 该潜变量可以充当一种未被观测到的动作：多种后续状态可能与同一观测相容，但只有一种会被实现。 对这种不确定性建模既需要一个转移机制，也需要一种生成缺失信息的方法。 图 1 展示了我们如何通过量子采样的潜动作将这两个组件连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn a transition by comparing a prediction with an encoded target ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) . A point-valued predictor supplies one representation for each observation. Stochastic extensions instead describe a distribution of successor representations ( Huang, 2026 ; Song et al., 2026 ) . We study how to learn this distribution through sampled latent actions. A useful prior must generate valid alternatives, coordinate dependent changes and remain compact as the action space grows. This motivates our joint study of the predictive-learning mechanism and the quantum circuits that implement its generative prior.
paragraphs.zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）通过将预测与编码目标进行比较来学习转移（Assran et al., 2023；Bardes et al., 2024）。 点值预测器为每次观测提供一个表示。 随机扩展则描述后继表示的分布（Huang, 2026；Song et al., 2026）。 我们研究如何通过采样的潜在动作来学习这一分布。 一个有用的先验必须能生成有效的备选方案，协调相关的变化，并随着动作空间的增长保持紧凑。 这促使我们联合研究预测学习机制以及实现其生成先验的量子电路。

paragraphs.en: Quantum machine learning explores how quantum representations and operations can contribute to learning, including generative tasks in which sampling is central ( Biamonte et al., 2017 ) . We bring this perspective to JEPA by using a conditional quantum circuit Born machine (QCBM) to generate latent actions. Measuring an n n -qubit register produces an n n -bit code; one shared neural predictor turns that code and the observation into a future representation. We optimize the resulting predictive distribution with an energy score. The observed future supplies a training signal for the conditional Born distribution through the predictions generated from its samples. We test both ideal-gradient optimization and parameter-shift gradients estimated from finite measurement samples, including a readout-error channel for our hardware-oriented reference circuits. Encoding each action as an n n -dimensional binary vector keeps the predictor interface linear in register size while sharing features across 2 n 2^{n} possible codes.
paragraphs.zh: 量子机器学习探索量子表示与运算如何为学习做出贡献，包括以采样为核心的生成式任务（ Biamonte et al., 2017 ）。 我们将这一视角引入 JEPA，使用条件量子线路 Born 机（QCBM）来生成潜在动作。 对一个 n n 量子比特寄存器进行测量会产出一个 n n 比特编码；一个共享的神经预测器将该编码与观测转化为未来表征。 我们用能量分数对所得的预测分布进行优化。 观测到的未来通过由其样本生成的预测，为条件 Born 分布提供训练信号。 我们测试了理想梯度优化和由有限测量样本估计的参数移位梯度，包括面向我们硬件的参考线路的读出误差信道。 将每个动作编码为 n n 维二进制向量，使预测器接口对寄存器规模保持线性，同时在 2 n 2^{n} 种可能的编码之间共享特征。

sents.zh: 我们测试了理想梯度优化和由有限测量样本估计的参数移位梯度，包括面向我们硬件的参考线路的读出误差信道。

sents.zh: 将每个动作编码为 n n 维二进制向量，使预测器接口对寄存器规模保持线性，同时在 2 n 2^{n} 种可能的编码之间共享特征。

paragraphs.en: Quantum Born machines offer a direct connection between binary latent variables and a physical sampling process. Product-QCBM circuits generate conditionally independent bits, while entangling gates allow correlated measurements ( Liu & Wang, 2018 ; Benedetti et al., 2019 ) . This provides a circuit-level way to encode correlations between latent actions. Classical autoregressive models and mixtures also generate correlations, and a shared neural predictor can create output dependence even from independent random inputs. We therefore restrict each local predictor to its own action bits in the multi-agent experiment, isolating the prior’s role in coordinating futures. Our comparison considers predictive quality, consistency across training runs and prior resources together, since each captures a different requirement of a useful world model.
paragraphs.zh: 量子玻恩机在二元潜在变量与物理采样过程之间提供了直接的联系。 乘积型QCBM电路生成条件独立的比特，而纠缠门则允许产生相关的测量结果 ( Liu & Wang, 2018 ; Benedetti et al., 2019 ) 。 这提供了一种在电路层面编码潜在动作之间相关性的方法。 经典自回归模型和混合模型同样能生成相关性，而且共享的神经预测器即使面对独立的随机输入也能产生输出之间的依赖。 因此，在多智能体实验中，我们将每个局部预测器限制在其自身的动作比特上，以隔离先验在协调未来中的作用。 我们的比较同时考虑预测质量、跨训练运行的一致性以及先验资源，因为每一项都体现了有用世界模型的一个不同要求。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the framework on stochastic MovingMNIST, HighwayEnv-Priority18 (HEP18), a controlled four-agent intersection with 18 coordinated futures, and public D3IL human demonstrations ( Jia et al., 2024 ) . The controlled tasks reveal mode recovery and coordination; D3IL tests learning from individual observed continuations and recursively predicting alternative routes from the same starting point. Comparisons with variational learning methods assess the predictive mechanism, while classical prior comparisons isolate the quantum implementation. Our experiments test whether sampled actions produce valid image continuations and coordinated motion, and whether those predictions retain the frequencies of alternative futures. Measurement-based training in simulation and real-QPU inference experiments test the two stages of this hybrid workflow. Our resource analysis compares the parameters, sampling operations and storage required by each prior. At fixed circuit depth, the QCBM uses linearly many conditional angles and local quantum gates rather than one logit for each joint code. On D3IL its prior uses fewer parameters than AR-GRU and Softmax-Categorical.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在随机MovingMNIST、HighwayEnv-Priority18（HEP18，一个包含18个协调未来分支的受控四智能体交叉口）以及公开的D3IL人类演示数据集（Jia et al., 2024）上评估该框架。 受控任务揭示模式恢复与协调能力；D3IL则测试从单个观测到的延续中学习，并从同一出发点递归地预测替代路线。 与变分学习方法的比较用于评估预测机制，而与经典先验的比较则用于隔离量子实现的影响。 我们的实验测试采样的动作是否能产生有效的图像延续和协调运动，以及这些预测是否保留了替代未来的频率。 基于测量的模拟训练和真实QPU推理实验测试了这一混合工作流的两个阶段。 我们的资源分析比较了每种先验所需的参数量、采样操作和存储。 在固定电路深度下，QCBM使用线性数量的条件角度和局部量子门，而不是为每个联合编码使用一个logit。 在D3IL上，其先验使用的参数少于AR-GRU和Softmax-Categorical。

sents.en: We evaluate the framework on stochastic MovingMNIST, HighwayEnv-Priority18 (HEP18), a controlled four-agent intersection with 18 coordinated futures, and public D3IL human demonstrations ( Jia et al., 2024 ) .

sents.zh: 与变分学习方法的比较用于评估预测机制，而与经典先验的比较则用于隔离量子实现的影响。

sents.en: Our experiments test whether sampled actions produce valid image continuations and coordinated motion, and whether those predictions retain the frequencies of alternative futures.
sents.zh: 我们的实验测试采样的动作是否能产生有效的图像延续和协调运动，以及这些预测是否保留了替代未来的频率。

sents.zh: 基于测量的模拟训练和真实QPU推理实验测试了这一混合工作流的两个阶段。

sents.en: Our resource analysis compares the parameters, sampling operations and storage required by each prior.
sents.zh: 我们的资源分析比较了每种先验所需的参数量、采样操作和存储。

sents.zh: 在固定电路深度下，QCBM使用线性数量的条件角度和局部量子门，而不是为每个联合编码使用一个logit。

sents.zh: 在D3IL上，其先验使用的参数少于AR-GRU和Softmax-Categorical。

paragraphs.en: A sampled latent-action JEPA framework that jointly learns future representations and a conditional generative prior, improving sample validity and distributional fidelity over the evaluated variational baselines on our controlled tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 一种采样式潜在动作 JEPA 框架，联合学习未来表征与条件生成先验，在我们受控任务上相比所评估的变分基线方法提升了样本有效性与分布保真度。

paragraphs.en: A trainable quantum Born implementation that learns alternative futures and useful cross-agent correlations through finite-shot parameter-shift training, together with deployment of trained priors on a QPU.
paragraphs.zh: 一种可训练的量子 Born 实现，通过有限次采样的参数移位训练学习替代未来与有用的跨智能体关联，并在 QPU 上部署训练得到的先验。

paragraphs.en: A performance–resource study spanning controlled multimodal tasks and public demonstrations, with strong autoregressive controls, recursive prediction and task-specific simplification checks. Our quantum priors offer a competitive quality–parameter trade-off through circuit-based sampling with a shared latent-action predictor.
paragraphs.zh: 一项涵盖受控多模态任务与公开演示的性能—资源研究，包含强自回归对照、递归预测以及任务特定的简化检验。 我们的方法通过基于电路的采样与共享的潜在动作预测器，提供了具有竞争力的质量—参数权衡，其量子先验发挥了重要作用。

sents.en: A performance–resource study spanning controlled multimodal tasks and public demonstrations, with strong autoregressive controls, recursive prediction and task-specific simplification checks.
sents.zh: 一项涵盖受控多模态任务与公开演示的性能—资源研究，包含强自回归对照、递归预测以及任务特定的简化检验。

sents.en: Our quantum priors offer a competitive quality–parameter trade-off through circuit-based sampling with a shared latent-action predictor.
sents.zh: 我们的方法通过基于电路的采样与共享的潜在动作预测器，提供了具有竞争力的质量—参数权衡，其量子先验发挥了重要作用。

paragraphs.en: Stochastic video models use learned latent variables to represent alternative continuations ( Denton & Fergus, 2018 ; Babaeizadeh et al., 2018 ) . JEPA moves prediction into representation space: I-JEPA and V-JEPA learn by predicting target embeddings ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) . Within this setting, Variational JEPA learns a predictive distribution through a variational formulation ( Huang, 2026 ) , while Branch-JEPA represents a context-weighted finite set of future embeddings and trains it with specialization or distributional scores ( Song et al., 2026 ) . FlowWM models stochastic futures directly in frozen pretrained visual features using conditional flow matching ( Porcher et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, we jointly train the JEPA encoder, shared predictor and discrete latent-action prior through a sampled predictive energy objective. Together, these works establish representation-space uncertainty modelling as a broader direction beyond point prediction. Our focus is how a sampled binary prior can learn through its consequences in a shared latent transition model. We separate two questions experimentally: how our sampled predictive-learning framework compares with other stochastic learning objectives, and how quantum and classical priors compare within that same framework.
paragraphs.zh: 随机视频模型使用学习到的潜变量来表示多种可能的后续展开（Denton & Fergus, 2018；Babaeizadeh et al., 2018）。 JEPA 将预测迁移到表示空间中：I-JEPA 和 V-JEPA 通过预测目标嵌入进行学习（Assran et al., 2023；Bardes et al., 2024）。 在此设定下，Variational JEPA 通过变分公式学习一个预测分布（Huang, 2026），而 Branch-JEPA 表示一个经上下文加权的有限未来嵌入集合，并使用专门化或分布得分对其进行训练（Song et al., 2026）。 FlowWM 在冻结的预训练视觉特征中，使用条件流匹配直接对随机未来进行建模（Porcher et al., 2026）。 与之相反，我们通过一个采样的预测能量目标，联合训练 JEPA 编码器、共享预测器和离散潜动作先验。 这些工作共同确立了表示空间中的不确定性建模作为超越点预测的一个更广泛的研究方向。 我们关注的是一个采样的二值先验如何通过其在共享潜转移模型中的后果来进行学习。 我们在实验中区分了两个问题：我们的采样预测学习框架与其他随机学习目标相比表现如何，以及在相同框架内量子先验与经典先验相比表现如何。

paragraphs.en: Action-conditioned world models predict the consequences of a supplied control. V-JEPA 2-AC extends pretrained predictive representations to this setting ( Assran et al., 2025 ) ; LeWorldModel (LeWM) learns latent dynamics from observation–action trajectories using prediction and SIGReg losses ( Maes et al., 2026 ) . When action labels are unavailable, latent-action models instead learn a control interface from observed changes. VQ-VAE provides a discrete representation through vector quantization ( van den Oord et al., 2017 ) , and LAPA and Genie learn action-like variables from videos without action labels ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ) . Work on latent-action world models in the wild also studies constrained continuous actions and transfer across videos ( Garrido et al., 2026 ) . We use latent actions to index possible continuations of the same observation. Their conditional distribution is learned jointly with predictive representations, and binary codes provide a direct interface to quantum measurements. Our intervention experiments test whether changing this interface redirects the learned continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 动作条件世界模型预测所给控制指令的后果。 V-JEPA 2-AC 将预训练的预测表征扩展到这一场景（Assran et al., 2025）；LeWorldModel（LeWM）使用预测损失和 SIGReg 损失从观察–动作轨迹中学习潜在动力学（Maes et al., 2026）。 当动作标签不可用时，潜在动作模型则从观察到的变化中学习一个控制接口。 VQ-VAE 通过向量量化提供离散表征（van den Oord et al., 2017），而 LAPA 和 Genie 从无动作标签的视频中学习类似动作的变量（Ye et al., 2025；Bruce et al., 2024）。 关于真实场景中潜在动作世界模型的工作还研究了受限连续动作以及跨视频的迁移（Garrido et al., 2026）。 我们使用潜在动作来索引同一观察的可能后续延续。 其条件分布与预测表征联合学习，而二进制编码为量子测量提供了直接的接口。 我们的干预实验检验改变这一接口是否能改变学习到的后续延续。

paragraphs.en: Proper scoring rules evaluate a predictive distribution against an observed outcome ( Gneiting & Raftery, 2007 ) . Energy scores are useful when a generator can sample but cannot conveniently evaluate its likelihood. Scoring-rule minimization has been developed for neural probabilistic forecasting ( Pacchiardi et al., 2024 ) . We use this sample-based interface to connect a generative prior to the JEPA prediction task: the score assesses the future embeddings produced from sampled actions and supplies the prior’s learning signal. Since the target space is learned, a predictive score alone does not prevent representation collapse. VICReg, LeJEPA and VISReg address this separate problem through feature regularization ( Bardes et al., 2022 ; Balestriero & LeCun, 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . Our framework combines a sampled predictive objective with VISReg; its quantum instance estimates prior gradients through circuit executions.
paragraphs.zh: 适当的评分规则根据观测到的结果来评估一个预测分布（Gneiting & Raftery, 2007）。 当生成器能够采样但无法便捷地评估其似然时，能量分数非常有用。 评分规则最小化已被应用于神经概率预测（Pacchiardi et al., 2024）。 我们利用这种基于样本的接口将生成式先验与 JEPA 预测任务连接起来：分数评估由采样动作产生的未来嵌入，并为先验提供学习信号。 由于目标空间是学习得到的，仅靠预测分数无法防止表征坍缩。 VICReg、LeJEPA 和 VISReg 通过特征正则化来解决这个独立的问题（Bardes et al., 2022；Balestriero & LeCun, 2025；Wu et al., 2026）。 我们的框架将基于采样的预测目标与 VISReg 相结合；其量子实例通过电路执行来估计先验的梯度。

paragraphs.en: Quantum circuit Born machines parameterize discrete probability distributions with trainable quantum circuits, drawing binary samples by measuring the states they prepare ( Liu & Wang, 2018 ; Benedetti et al., 2019 ) . Conditional versions use classical side information to adapt the circuit’s output distribution to a given input ( Kiss et al., 2022 ) . Parameter-shift rules make derivatives accessible through shifted circuit executions ( Schuld et al., 2019 ) . Their usefulness depends on the loss and ansatz: quantum generative modelling can encounter trainability barriers, including weak statistical signals in high-dimensional objectives ( Rudolph et al., 2024 ) . HQ-JEPA uses a quantum fidelity loss for cross-modal remote-sensing representation learning, with its quantum module evaluated through classical simulation ( Hossain et al., 2026 ) . We instead place the circuit in the generative prior, where it samples latent actions and learns through their downstream predictive energy. This ties quantum distribution learning to future uncertainty in a learned world model. We also deploy trained priors on a real QPU and pass their measured actions through the complete prediction pipeline. This establishes inference feasibility beyond simulation and complements our classical-prior comparisons and correlation tests.
paragraphs.zh: 量子线路玻恩机使用可训练的量子线路对离散概率分布进行参数化，并通过测量其制备的量子态来抽取二值样本（Liu & Wang, 2018；Benedetti et al., 2019）。 其条件版本利用经典侧信息，使线路的输出分布适应给定的输入（Kiss et al., 2022）。 参数移位规则通过移位后的线路执行来获得导数（Schuld et al., 2019）。 其实用性取决于损失函数与拟设：量子生成建模可能遇到可训练性障碍，包括高维目标中的微弱统计信号（Rudolph et al., 2024）。 HQ-JEPA 将量子保真度损失用于跨模态遥感表征学习，其量子模块通过经典模拟进行评估（Hossain et al., 2026）。 我们则将量子线路置于生成先验之中，由其采样潜在动作，并通过这些动作的下游预测能量进行学习。 这将量子分布学习与所学世界模型中的未来不确定性联系起来。 我们还在真实 QPU 上部署训练好的先验，并将其测量得到的动作送入完整的预测流程。 这确立了超出模拟范围的推理可行性，并补充了我们的经典先验对比与相关性测试。

paragraphs.en: The body layers act in temporal order, followed by the terminal rotations and computational-basis measurement; θ = ( η , ϑ , φ ) \theta=(\eta,\vartheta,\varphi) . Each E ℓ E_{\ell} is a fixed CNOT matching, or the identity for the product circuit. The conditioner is a two-layer SiLU MLP whose output layer starts at zero. paragraphs.en: Within each experiment, stochastic discrete-prior comparisons share the encoder, predictor, loss, readout and training schedule. Deterministic JEPA predicts one future per observation; Uniform-Bernoulli uses independent fair bits, and Frozen-QCBM keeps the initialized prior fixed. Softmax-Categorical learns one probability per code, whereas Independent-Bernoulli learns a separate probability for each bit. AR-GRU conditions each bit on preceding bits; a Bernoulli mixture first samples a shared component and then draws conditionally independent bits. Product-QCBM uses single-qubit rotations, while Entangled-QCBM adds CNOT gates between them to couple the sampled bits. Mixture-2 for MovingMNIST and Mixture-4 for HEP18 and D3IL have parameter counts close to the corresponding QCBM. For complete-method comparisons, our Variational JEPA adaptation ( Huang, 2026 ) predicts a mean representation and calibrates Gaussian uncertainty. Latent-CVAE ( Denton & Fergus, 2018 ; Babaeizadeh et al., 2018 ) learns a future-conditioned posterior and context-conditioned prior with a reconstruction–KL objective. Both use their own objectives with matched data, readouts and evaluation budgets. The reference results in Tables 2 and 3 use three independent trainings and 128 actual prior draws per observation. Their trained QCBMs use finite-shot parameter shift with independent 0.5% readout bit flips during training and evaluation; classical methods and fixed controls retain their stated sampling protocols. Appendix D compares this setting with ideal gradients and noise-free parameter shift. D3IL training covers three seeds across three demonstration folds; the common-start diagnostic evaluates all nine models per method. Its trainable QCBMs also use finite-shot parameter shift with 0.5% readout bit flips; the frozen quantum control receives the same readout noise. We report each experiment separately, without pooling checkpoints across circuit families, gradient estimators or data splits. Architectures, optimizers and external adaptations appear in Appendices A , C and E .
paragraphs.zh: 在每个实验内部，随机离散先验的对比实验共享相同的编码器、预测器、损失、读出层与训练日程。 确定性 JEPA 对每次观测预测一个未来；Uniform-Bernoulli 使用独立的均匀比特，Frozen-QCBM 则保持初始化后的先验固定不变。 Softmax-Categorical 为每个码学习一个概率，而 Independent-Bernoulli 为每个比特单独学习一个概率。 AR-GRU 将每一比特条件于其前的比特；Bernoulli 混合模型先采样一个共享的成分，再从中抽取条件独立的比特。 Product-QCBM 只使用单量子比特旋转门，而 Entangled-QCBM 在其间加入 CNOT 门以耦合被采样的比特。 Mixture-2（用于 MovingMNIST）与 Mixture-4（用于 HEP18 和 D3IL）的参数量与相应的 QCBM 接近。 在完整方法的对比中，我们的变分 JEPA 改编版（Huang, 2026）预测一个均值表征并校准高斯不确定性。 Latent-CVAE（Denton & Fergus, 2018；Babaeizadeh et al., 2018）通过重建–KL 目标学习以未来为条件的后验和以上下文为条件的先验。 两者都使用各自的目标函数，并在匹配的数据、读出层与评估预算下运行。 表 2 和表 3 中的参考结果使用了三次独立训练以及每次观测 128 次实际先验采样。 其训练的 QCBM 在训练与评估中均使用有限次测量的参数移位法，并带有独立的 0.5% 读出比特翻转；经典方法与固定对照则保持其所述的采样协议。 附录 D 将该设定与理想梯度及无噪声的参数移位法进行了比较。 D3IL 的训练覆盖三个演示折与三个随机种子；共同起点的诊断评估则对每个方法的全部九个模型进行评测。 其可训练的 QCBM 同样使用有限次测量的参数移位法并带有 0.5% 的读出比特翻转；冻结的量子对照也接受相同的读出噪声。 我们对每个实验分别报告结果，不在不同电路族、梯度估计器或数据划分之间合并检查点。 体系结构、优化器与外部改编方法分别见附录 A、C 与 E。

paragraphs.en: We construct a stochastic single-digit variant of MovingMNIST ( Srivastava et al., 2015 ) using 64 × 64 64\times 64 videos with three horizontal-motion observation frames and three future frames. Eight equally spaced directions have probabilities 0.15 for each cardinal direction and 0.10 for each diagonal direction. We use 800 training and 80 test observations from disjoint MNIST splits. Training receives image pairs, not motion labels; a three-bit prior learns the action codes. These frequencies admit a product-bit representation, so this task does not require entanglement. We train with Eq. 10 , using VISReg on the observation and target representations. A separately trained frozen-JEPA readout predicts translations and renders future images from the last observation frame. Appendix F.2 gives the full construction and readout protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于 64 × 64 64\times 64 的视频构建了 MovingMNIST（ Srivastava et al., 2015 ）的随机个位数变体，其中包含三个水平运动观测帧和三个未来帧。 八个等间距方向中，每个基数方向的概率为 0.15，每个对角方向的概率为 0.10。 我们使用来自互不相交的 MNIST 划分的 800 个训练观测和 80 个测试观测。 训练接收的是图像对而非运动标签；一个三比特先验学习动作编码。 这些频率允许一种乘积比特表示，因此该任务不需要纠缠。 我们使用公式 10 进行训练，并在观测表示和目标表示上使用 VISReg。 一个单独训练的冻结 JEPA 读出模块预测平移，并根据最后一个观测帧渲染未来图像。 附录 F.2 给出了完整的构建和读出协议。

paragraphs.en: HEP18 is a controlled four-agent task on HighwayEnv’s straight intersection lanes ( Leurent, 2018 ) . Each observation admits 18 equally likely futures: either NS or EW has priority, each priority vehicle chooses one of three speed schedules, and both yielding vehicles decelerate to a stop. The reference experiment splits 448 observations into 256 training, 64 validation and 128 test contexts, keeping each observation’s futures together. We train the JEPA for 6,000 updates and fit the readout for 16,000 updates. All 18 futures are available during HEP18 training; their probabilities are uniform and do not depend on the initial state. The model consumes structured position–speed histories and predicts three stages over nine seconds.
paragraphs.zh: HEP18 是在 HighwayEnv 直线交叉口车道上的一个受控四智能体任务（Leurent, 2018）。 每个观测有 18 种等可能的未来：NS 或 EW 一方拥有优先权，每个优先行驶的智能体车辆选择三种速度方案之一，且两辆让行车辆都减速至停止。 参考实验将 448 个观测划分为 256 个训练、64 个验证和 128 个测试情境，并将每个观测的未来保持在一起。 我们训练 JEPA 共 6,000 次更新，并拟合读出层共 16,000 次更新。 在 HEP18 训练期间，所有 18 种未来都可用；它们的概率是均匀的，且不依赖于初始状态。 该模型接收结构化的位置–速度历史，并在九秒内预测三个阶段。

paragraphs.en: We use 96 public human demonstrations from D3IL Avoiding ( Jia et al., 2024 ) , a simulated robotic obstacle-avoidance task with three obstacle rows. We train the models on observed planar trajectories, without enumerating alternative futures for each observation or supplying route labels to the model. We train on demonstration-disjoint folds of 64 trajectories, reserving 32 in each fold, with three training seeds and eight methods. For the common-start evaluation below, we evaluate all nine trained models per method. We average the three folds within each training seed, then report the mean and sample standard deviation of the three seed-level means. Figures use the first training seed and first fold for every method, without selecting checkpoints by performance. The dataset informed earlier development, and this diagnostic is not a previously untouched blind test.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用来自 D3IL Avoiding ( Jia et al., 2024 ) 的 96 条公开人类演示，这是一个包含三排障碍物的仿真机器人避障任务。 我们在观测到的平面轨迹上训练模型，不为每个观测枚举可能的未来，也不向模型提供路径标签。 我们在演示不相交的 64 条轨迹折上训练，每折保留 32 条轨迹，使用三个训练种子和八种方法。 对于下文的共同起点评估，我们对每种方法的全部九个训练后模型进行评估。 我们在每个训练种子内对三折取平均，然后报告三个种子级均值的均值和样本标准差。 图中使用每种方法的第一个训练种子和第一折，不按性能挑选检查点。 该数据集曾用于早期开发，因此这一诊断并非此前未曾接触过的盲测。

paragraphs.en: An observation is a 24-point trajectory segment. We predict the next 8 cm of motion, also represented by 24 points, using eight latent-action bits. After decoding a prediction, we re-encode its coordinates for the next step. We stop at the goal line or after 16 calls, retaining failures in evaluation. This is offline recursive prediction, not robot execution. Training uses the Euclidean energy score and VISReg on h h and t t . Here Entangled-QCBM uses four layers of local rotations and brickwork CNOT gates, followed by terminal local rotations; Product-QCBM omits the CNOTs. Frozen-QCBM retains its input-independent initialized distribution while the encoder and predictor learn. Deterministic JEPA uses representation MSE in place of the energy score. AR-GRU uses the same recurrent prior architecture as in the other two tasks. A frozen-JEPA spline readout translates future features into coordinates. We retain a final 1,000-update predictor/prior stage on real consecutive segments, with encoder and readout fixed. Appendix B gives all stages and architecture differences, including the CVAE schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 一个观测是 24 点的轨迹片段。 我们使用八个潜动作比特预测接下来 8 厘米的运动，同样用 24 个点表示。 解码一个预测后，我们将其坐标重新编码用于下一步。 我们在到达目标线或调用 16 次后停止，并在评估中保留失败情况。 这是离线递归预测，而非机器人执行。 训练使用欧氏能量分数以及在 h h 和 t t 上的 VISReg。 这里 Entangled-QCBM 使用四层局部旋转门和砖块式 CNOT 门，随后是末端的局部旋转门；Product-QCBM 则省去 CNOT 门。 Frozen-QCBM 在编码器和预测器学习的同时，保留其与输入无关的初始分布。 确定性 JEPA 用表示 MSE 代替能量分数。 AR-GRU 使用与其他两个任务相同的循环先验架构。 冻结的 JEPA 样条读出层将未来特征转换为坐标。 我们在真实连续片段上保留最后 1,000 次更新的预测器/先验阶段，此时编码器和读出层固定不动。 附录 B 给出所有阶段及架构差异，包括 CVAE 的训练计划。

sents.en: Frozen-QCBM retains its input-independent initialized distribution while the encoder and predictor learn.
sents.zh: Frozen-QCBM 在编码器和预测器学习的同时，保留其与输入无关的初始分布。

sents.en: Deterministic JEPA uses representation MSE in place of the energy score.
sents.zh: 确定性 JEPA 用表示 MSE 代替能量分数。

sents.en: AR-GRU uses the same recurrent prior architecture as in the other two tasks.
sents.zh: AR-GRU 使用与其他两个任务相同的循环先验架构。

sents.zh: 冻结的 JEPA 样条读出层将未来特征转换为坐标。

sents.en: We retain a final 1,000-update predictor/prior stage on real consecutive segments, with encoder and readout fixed.

sents.en: Appendix B gives all stages and architecture differences, including the CVAE schedule.

paragraphs.en: All 96 recorded trajectories begin at exactly the same planar position. We use that point as the entire initial observation, repeating it 24 times to retain the encoder’s input shape without supplying a motion direction. Subsequent calls re-encode the predicted segment as usual. During training, the first observation is a moving segment interpolated from recorded frames 4–8. At evaluation, we keep the trained models fixed and begin prediction at the shared stationary point, before any motion has been observed.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 96 条记录的轨迹都始于完全相同的平面位置。 我们将该点用作全部初始观测，重复 24 次以保持编码器的输入形状，同时不提供运动方向。 后续调用照常对预测的片段重新编码。 在训练期间，第一个观测是由记录的第 4–8 帧插值得到的运动片段。 在评估时，我们保持训练好的模型不变，并在任何运动被观测到之前，从共享的静止点开始预测。

paragraphs.en: Coverage measures how many true futures are recovered; validity measures the fraction of draws matching a true future. Total variation (TV) compares sampled mode frequencies, including an invalid category, with the target distribution. MovingMNIST uses a 4-pixel endpoint threshold. HEP18 requires every agent to match the same joint target within 2 m and 1 m/s at all future times. We also report minimum ADE and Euclidean trajectory energy score (ES). Independently re-pairing agents’ predictions preserves their marginals but disrupts coordination. Appendix F.4 gives complete definitions and Appendix H reports tolerance and sampling-budget checks.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖率衡量恢复了多少真实未来；有效性衡量采样结果中匹配真实未来所占的比例。 总变差（TV）将采样到的模式频率（包括无效类别）与目标分布进行比较。 MovingMNIST 使用 4 像素的终点阈值。 HEP18 要求每个智能体在所有未来时刻均以 2 米和 1 米/秒的容差匹配同一联合目标。 我们还报告最小 ADE 和欧氏轨迹能量得分（ES）。 独立地重新配对各智能体的预测会保留其边缘分布，但会破坏协调性。 附录 F.4 给出完整定义，附录 H 报告容差与采样预算检查。

sents.zh: 我们还报告最小 ADE 和欧氏轨迹能量得分（ES）。

sents.zh: 独立地重新配对各智能体的预测会保留其边缘分布，但会破坏协调性。

paragraphs.en: For D3IL, the three obstacle rows define 2 × 3 × 4 = 24 2\times 3\times 4=24 routes. We draw 384 recursive continuations per checkpoint from the same point. A geometrically accepted path reaches the goal, crosses all three rows, avoids continuous-path collisions and passes a workspace-envelope check. We report the exact expected route coverage and TV of a uniform random subset of 60 accepted paths, against the uniform 24-route reference. One Latent-CVAE checkpoint supplies only 61 accepted paths; the common 60-path budget retains every stochastic checkpoint without additional draws. Unlike the controlled-task TV above, this TV is conditioned on geometric validity; it does not measure the probability of producing an invalid path. All raw candidates are retained. Appendix B.4 gives the definitions, the empirical demonstration reference and a finite-pool sampling-sensitivity check.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 D3IL，三行障碍物定义了 2 × 3 × 4 = 24 2\times 3\times 4=24 条路线。 我们在每个检查点处从同一点抽取 384 条递归延续。 几何上可接受的路径需到达目标、穿过全部三行、避免连续路径碰撞，并通过工作空间包络检查。 我们针对 60 条可接受路径的均匀随机子集，报告其相对于均匀 24 条路线参考的精确期望路线覆盖率和 TV。 一个 Latent-CVAE 检查点仅提供 61 条可接受路径；共同的 60 条路径预算无需额外抽取即可保留每个随机检查点。 与上文受控任务的 TV 不同，此 TV 以几何有效性为条件；它不衡量生成无效路径的概率。 所有原始候选均被保留。 附录 B.4 给出了定义、经验演示参考以及有限池采样敏感性检查。

paragraphs.en: Both quantum circuit structures learn multiple image continuations under finite-shot parameter-shift training with readout noise ( Table 2 ). Their validity, trajectory errors and energy scores remain close to the strongest within-framework classical priors. Softmax-Categorical has better frequency matching, while QCBM uses fewer prior parameters ( Table 7 ). Product-QCBM performs comparably to Entangled-QCBM on this task: the target frequencies admit a product-bit representation, so entanglement is not required. The paired training comparisons in Appendix D show that these conclusions survive replacing ideal gradients with measurement-based estimates. Figure 3 shows the continuations produced by different latent-action codes, including unsuccessful predictions. Changing the code redirects the continuation, but its direction need not be identical across digit images. Appendix I tests whether the Born prior adapts to different direction probabilities for different digits.
paragraphs.zh: 两种量子电路结构在含读出噪声的有限样本参数移位训练下都能学习多个图像延续（表 2）。 它们的有效性、轨迹误差和能量得分仍然接近框架内最强的经典先验。 Softmax-Categorical 的频率匹配更好，而 QCBM 使用的先验参数更少（表 7）。 Product-QCBM 在该任务上的表现与 Entangled-QCBM 相当：目标频率具有乘积比特表示，因此不需要纠缠。 附录 D 中的成对训练比较表明，在用基于测量的估计替代理想梯度后，这些结论依然成立。 图 3 展示了不同潜在动作编码生成的延续，包括失败的预测。 改变编码会改变延续的方向，但该方向在不同数字图像之间未必一致。 附录 I 检验了 Born 先验是否能针对不同数字适应不同的方向概率。

paragraphs.en: Entangled-QCBM recovers nearly all coordinated futures under noisy parameter-shift training ( Table 3 ). It outperforms Product-QCBM and Frozen-QCBM, while the strongest classical priors retain higher mean validity.
paragraphs.zh: 在含噪参数移位训练下，纠缠态QCBM（Entangled-QCBM）恢复了几乎所有协同期货（表 3）。 其表现优于乘积QCBM（Product-QCBM）和冻结QCBM（Frozen-QCBM），而最强的经典先验仍保持更高的平均有效率。

sents.en: Entangled-QCBM recovers nearly all coordinated futures under noisy parameter-shift training ( Table 3 ).
sents.zh: 在含噪参数移位训练下，纠缠态QCBM（Entangled-QCBM）恢复了几乎所有协同期货（表 3）。

paragraphs.en: For the three Entangled-QCBM runs in Table 3 , re-pairing agents within each test observation reduces mean joint validity from 93.38% to 12.71%. All four agents are individually valid in 96.61% of original scenes, showing that local plausibility alone does not ensure coordination. We use ten independent permutations per observation (Appendix F.4 ).

paragraphs.en: Our trained quantum priors generate multiple obstacle-crossing routes even when the initial observation contains no motion direction ( Tables 4 and 4 ). Across the repeated models, both trainable QCBMs recover a comparable number of routes to Softmax-Categorical and AR-GRU. Softmax-Categorical has the lowest mean TV, with Product-QCBM and AR-GRU close behind. Each deterministic checkpoint returns only one repeated path, so it cannot express multiple alternatives from this input.
paragraphs.zh: 我们训练得到的量子先验能够生成多条越障路线，即使初始观测中不包含运动方向（见表 4 和表 4）。 在重复实验的模型中，两个可训练的 QCBM 恢复出的路线数量与 Softmax-Categorical 和 AR-GRU 相当。 Softmax-Categorical 的平均 TV 最低，Product-QCBM 和 AR-GRU 紧随其后。 每个确定性检查点只能返回一条重复的路径，因此无法从该输入表达多种备选方案。

paragraphs.en: Product-QCBM covers more routes in the illustrated 64-path sample, but the repeated-model analysis gives similar coverage for the two circuit families. Appendix B.4 separates variation across trained models from selection of a finite display sample. More fundamentally, independent latent bits do not require independent trajectory choices: the shared nonlinear predictor and recursive re-encoding can map product-distributed codes into correlated routes. This differs from HEP18, where separate agent predictors restrict how stochastic coordination can arise. Product-QCBM sampling is consequently a sufficient source of diverse latent actions for this D3IL setting; the results do not establish a stable advantage from adding entanglement.
paragraphs.zh: 在图示的 64 条路径样本中，Product-QCBM 覆盖了更多路线，但重复模型分析显示两种线路家族的覆盖率相近。 附录 B.4 将训练模型之间的差异与有限展示样本的选择区分开来。 更根本地说，独立的潜在比特并不要求独立的轨迹选择：共享的非线性预测器和递归重编码可以将乘积分布的编码映射为相关的路线。 这与 HEP18 不同，在 HEP18 中，分离的智能体预测器限制了随机协调产生的可能性。 因此，Product-QCBM 采样足以为该 D3IL 设定提供多样的潜在动作来源；这些结果并未证明加入纠缠能带来稳定优势。

paragraphs.en: We use geometric acceptance only to define the route-distribution analysis, not to alter generation or optimize the models. No collision penalty or obstacle-based correction is used during training or recursive prediction. The current protocol measures route diversity conditional on geometric acceptance; it does not evaluate a learned collision-avoidance objective. Its frequency estimates concern one initial input and accepted trajectories. Training with the same stationary first input would remove the initial-input mismatch tested here.
paragraphs.zh: 我们仅使用几何接受度来定义路线分布分析，而不用于改变生成过程或优化模型。 在训练或递归预测过程中，不使用碰撞惩罚或基于障碍物的修正。 当前协议衡量的是以几何接受度为条件的路线多样性；它并不评估学习到的碰撞规避目标。 其频率估计仅涉及单一初始输入和被接受的轨迹。 若使用相同的静态第一输入进行训练，将消除此处所测试的初始输入不匹配问题。

paragraphs.en: Our correlated classical and quantum implementations improve validity, TV and energy score over both external adaptations ( Tables 2 and 3 ), identifying a framework-level benefit. Latent-CVAE has higher coverage and lower minimum ADE on MovingMNIST ( Table 2 ), but many draws fall between valid continuations. On HEP18, our correlated models also improve coverage and trajectory error. Appendix E.1 discusses these benchmark adaptations and their distance–coordination trade-offs.

paragraphs.en: We ran trained quantum priors on real QPUs and used their sampled actions in the complete prediction pipeline. Hardware noise can change the latent-action distribution and, in turn, the frequencies of predicted futures. This shift can improve or reduce individual benchmark metrics; its effect depends on the learned distribution, task and metric. On MovingMNIST, the reference RY/CNOT and Product-QCBM circuits closely matched the ideal-sampling results ( Table 14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在真实 QPU 上运行了训练好的量子先验，并将其采样得到的动作用于完整的预测流程。 硬件噪声会改变隐动作分布，进而改变所预测未来的频率。 这种偏移可能提升或降低个别基准指标；其影响取决于学习到的分布、任务和指标。 在 MovingMNIST 上，参考的 RY/CNOT 电路和 Product-QCBM 电路与理想采样结果 closely matched（见表 14）。

paragraphs.en: For HEP18’s 12-qubit circuit, hardware errors reduced joint prediction validity. We improved execution by choosing better-performing physical qubits and connections, without retraining or changing the circuit’s ideal distribution. Joint validity rose from 76.88% to 86.69%, compared with 98.41% under ideal sampling. After optimization, coverage and trajectory errors were close to the ideal reference ( Table 15 ). Appendix J details these hardware implementations and their matched evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 HEP18 的 12 量子比特电路，硬件错误降低了联合预测的有效性。 我们通过选择性能更好的物理量子比特及其连接来改进执行，而无需重新训练或改变电路的理想分布。 联合有效性从 76.88% 提升至 86.69%，而理想采样下的结果为 98.41%。 优化后，覆盖率和轨迹误差接近理想参考值（Table 15）。 附录 J 详细介绍了这些硬件实现及其配套的评估。

paragraphs.en: On D3IL, the trained Product-QCBM and Entangled-QCBM priors generated the latent actions for complete recursive trajectory prediction. Their route coverage fell within the ranges observed across matched GPU sampling repetitions. Each recursive step requires a new conditional circuit execution, so we used a smaller hardware budget of 40 raw rollouts per prior. We matched the GPU runs to this budget; the main D3IL comparison uses 384 raw rollouts per checkpoint. Appendix J.3 explains the resulting differences in sample counts and reports the matched comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 在 D3IL 上，训练得到的 Product-QCBM 和 Entangled-QCBM 先验生成了用于完整递归轨迹预测的潜在动作。 它们的路线覆盖落在匹配的 GPU 采样重复实验所观察到的范围之内。 每个递归步骤都需要一次新的条件线路执行，因此我们对每个先验使用了较小的硬件预算，即 40 次原始 rollout。 我们将 GPU 运行匹配到该预算；主 D3IL 对比在每个检查点上使用 384 次原始 rollout。 附录 J.3 说明了由此产生的样本数量差异，并报告了匹配后的对比结果。

sents.zh: 在 D3IL 上，训练得到的 Product-QCBM 和 Entangled-QCBM 先验生成了用于完整递归轨迹预测的潜在动作。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Quantum-JEPA, which trains a conditional Born prior through the predictive consequences of sampled latent actions. Our model learns multimodal and coordinated futures on constructed tasks and produces recursive predictions from diverse human demonstrations in D3IL under finite-shot, noisy training. On the controlled tasks, our framework improves over the evaluated variational baselines through classical and quantum prior implementations. On D3IL, the trained quantum priors produce diverse routes from a common direction-free starting point, with route coverage comparable to classical discrete priors in this fixed-input diagnostic. Within this framework, our quantum priors offer competitive prediction quality and a parameter-efficient representation of binary action distributions. We validate finite-shot parameter-shift training and real-QPU inference, establishing a practical route for quantum generative models to participate in representation-space future prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Quantum-JEPA，通过采样潜在动作的预测后果训练条件玻恩先验。 在有限次样本且含噪声的训练条件下，我们的模型在构造任务上学习多模态且协调的未来，并在 D3IL 基准中从多样的人类演示中产生递归预测。 在受控任务上，通过经典先验和量子先验两种实现，我们的框架均优于所评估的变分基线。 在 D3IL 上，训练得到的量子先验能从同一个无方向起始点生成多样的路线，在该固定输入的诊断实验中，其路线覆盖率与经典离散先验相当。 在该框架内，我们的量子先验提供了具有竞争力的预测质量，以及对二元动作分布的参数高效表示。 我们验证了有限次样本的参数移位训练与真实 QPU 推理，为量子生成模型参与表示空间中的未来预测建立了一条可行的路径。

sents.zh: 我们验证了有限次样本的参数移位训练与真实 QPU 推理，为量子生成模型参与表示空间中的未来预测建立了一条可行的路径。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments establish training and inference feasibility, but the quantum priors do not consistently outperform strong classical methods across all predictive metrics. Our current circuits are shallow, with performance and optimization stability depending on the task and circuit. Larger implementations face hardware noise and substantial measurement costs. We will develop circuit structures and training algorithms tailored to multimodal prediction and correlated latent actions, and investigate quantum implementations of more of the JEPA predictor. We will also formulate latent-action reasoning and planning as optimization problems for special-purpose quantum platforms.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验证明了训练和推理的可行性，但量子先验并非在所有预测指标上都始终优于强基线的经典方法。 我们目前的电路较为浅层，其性能与优化稳定性取决于任务和电路。 更大规模的实现面临硬件噪声和高昂的测量成本。 我们将开发面向多模态预测和相关潜在动作的电路结构与训练算法，并研究 JEPA 预测器中更多部分的量子实现。 我们还将把潜在动作推理与规划表述为优化问题，以用于专用量子平台。

paragraphs.en: We apply layer normalization, a d → H p d\!\rightarrow\!H_{p} linear layer, SiLU, and an H p → 2 n H_{p}\!\rightarrow\!2^{n} output layer. The output gives one logit for every possible binary code. We draw a categorical index and convert it to an n n -bit string. We evaluate this prior at both three and twelve bits. At twelve bits, its explicit enumeration of code probabilities requires more parameters than the other priors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们应用层归一化、一个 d → H_p 的线性层、SiLU 激活函数，以及一个 H_p → 2^n 的输出层。 该输出为每个可能的二进制码提供一个 logit。 我们抽取一个类别索引并将其转换为 n 位二进制字符串。 我们在三比特和十二比特两种设置下评估该先验。 在十二比特时，其对码概率的显式枚举需要比其他先验更多的参数。

sents.en: We apply layer normalization, a d → H p d\!\rightarrow\!H_{p} linear layer, SiLU, and an H p → 2 n H_{p}\!\rightarrow\!2^{n} output layer.
sents.zh: 我们应用层归一化、一个 d → H_p 的线性层、SiLU 激活函数，以及一个 H_p → 2^n 的输出层。

sents.en: The output gives one logit for every possible binary code.
sents.zh: 该输出为每个可能的二进制码提供一个 logit。

sents.en: We draw a categorical index and convert it to an n n -bit string.
sents.zh: 我们抽取一个类别索引并将其转换为 n 位二进制字符串。

sents.en: We evaluate this prior at both three and twelve bits.
sents.zh: 我们在三比特和十二比特两种设置下评估该先验。

paragraphs.en: This prior uses the same conditioner architecture, but its output layer produces n n logits. Each logit defines one bit’s probability of being one, and we sample the bits independently.
paragraphs.zh: 该先验使用相同的调节器架构，但其输出层产生 n n 个 logits。 每个 logit 定义其中一位取 1 的概率，我们对各个位进行独立采样。

sents.en: This prior uses the same conditioner architecture, but its output layer produces n n logits.
sents.zh: 该先验使用相同的调节器架构，但其输出层产生 n n 个 logits。

sents.en: Each logit defines one bit’s probability of being one, and we sample the bits independently.
sents.zh: 每个 logit 定义其中一位取 1 的概率，我们对各个位进行独立采样。

paragraphs.en: We project the layer-normalized observation representation into a width- H p H_{p} hidden state. A shared GRU cell generates the bits sequentially, receiving the previous bit as input. The initial input bit is zero, and a shared scalar output head predicts the next Bernoulli logit. Later bits can therefore depend on both the observation and earlier sampled bits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将经过层归一化的观测表示投影到一个宽度为 H_p H_{p} 的隐状态中。 一个共享的 GRU 单元按顺序生成各个比特，并将前一个比特作为输入。 初始输入比特为零，一个共享的标量输出头预测下一个伯努利分布的 logit。 因此，后面的比特可以同时依赖于观测和之前已采样的比特。

sents.en: We project the layer-normalized observation representation into a width- H p H_{p} hidden state.
sents.zh: 我们将经过层归一化的观测表示投影到一个宽度为 H_p H_{p} 的隐状态中。

sents.en: A shared GRU cell generates the bits sequentially, receiving the previous bit as input.
sents.zh: 一个共享的 GRU 单元按顺序生成各个比特，并将前一个比特作为输入。

sents.en: The initial input bit is zero, and a shared scalar output head predicts the next Bernoulli logit.
sents.zh: 初始输入比特为零，一个共享的标量输出头预测下一个伯努利分布的 logit。

sents.en: Later bits can therefore depend on both the observation and earlier sampled bits.
sents.zh: 因此，后面的比特可以同时依赖于观测和之前已采样的比特。

paragraphs.en: A SiLU MLP maps the layer-normalized observation through widths d → H p → R ⁡ ( n + 1 ) d\!\rightarrow\!H_{p}\!\rightarrow\!R(n+1) . Its outputs are R R component logits and R ​ n Rn Bernoulli logits. We first sample one mixture component, then sample all bits independently using that component’s Bernoulli probabilities. For the training update, we compute each sampled code’s probability by summing over components, using log-sum-exp for numerical stability.
paragraphs.zh: 一个 SiLU 多层感知机将层归一化后的观测映射为维度 d → H_p → R(n+1)。 其输出为 R 个分量 logits 和 Rn 个伯努利 logits。 我们先采样一个混合分量，再使用该分量的伯努利概率独立采样所有比特。 在训练更新时，我们通过对各分量求和来计算每个采样编码的概率，并使用 log-sum-exp 以保证数值稳定性。

paragraphs.en: The shared encoder takes a three-frame clip, stacking the frames as input channels. It then applies convolutions → 24 3\!\rightarrow\!24 ( 5 × 5 5\times 5 ), → 48 24\!\rightarrow\!48 ( 3 × 3 3\times 3 ), and → 64 48\!\rightarrow\!64 ( 3 × 3 3\times 3 ). All three layers use stride 2 and SiLU, with padding of 2, 1 and 1 pixels, respectively. These layers reduce the spatial resolution from 64 × 64 64\times 64 to 8 × 8 8\times 8 . We flatten the resulting 64 × 8 × 8 64\times 8\times 8 feature grid and map it through fully connected widths 96 and 64, followed by layer normalization. The predictor follows Eqs. 5 and 6 with width 96 and layer normalization at its output. Appendix C describes the two-layer, three-qubit circuit.
paragraphs.zh: 共享编码器接收一个三帧片段，将各帧堆叠为输入通道。 随后依次应用卷积层 → 24 3\!\rightarrow\!24 （ 5 × 5 5\times 5 ）、→ 48 24\!\rightarrow\!48 （ 3 × 3 3\times 3 ）以及 → 64 48\!\rightarrow\!64 （ 3 × 3 3\times 3 ）。 这三层均使用步长 2 和 SiLU 激活，填充分别为 2、1 和 1 个像素。 这些层将空间分辨率从 64 × 64 64\times 64 降低到 8 × 8 8\times 8 。 我们将得到的 64 × 8 × 8 64\times 8\times 8 特征网格展平，依次通过宽度为 96 和 64 的全连接层，并进行层归一化。 预测器遵循公式 5 和公式 6，宽度为 96，并在其输出处进行层归一化。 附录 C 描述了该双层三量子比特电路。

paragraphs.en: The readout minimizes weighted image L1 error, mean ⁡ [ ( 1 + 4 ​ y ) ​ | y ^ − y | ] \operatorname{mean}[(1+4y)|\widehat{y}-y|] , plus one half of the soft Dice loss. Here y y and y ^ \widehat{y} are the target and predicted pixel intensities. The L1 weight emphasizes digit pixels, while Dice measures image overlap. We average over frames and use Dice smoothing 10 − 6 10^{-6} . The readout’s final layer is initialized to zero, so its initial predictions have zero displacement. We train it for 4,000 iterations with batch size 64. AdamW uses learning rate 0.002 0.002 , weight decay 0.01 0.01 , and gradient clipping at norm 5.

paragraphs.en: Each agent’s encoder receives its three position–speed pairs as six scalars. The shared MLP has hidden widths 64 and 64, SiLU activations, and a 16-dimensional output. Concatenating the four agent outputs gives the scene representation with d = 64 d=64 . The residual predictor uses a width-64 local-code MLP. Its output remains in the encoder’s coordinates, without output normalization.

paragraphs.en: The trajectory readout is a shared → → 3 16\!\rightarrow\!64\!\rightarrow\!3 SiLU MLP. It receives an agent’s encoded target during readout training and its predicted representation at inference. The three outputs give speeds bounded by 12 ​ sigmoid ⁡ ( a ) 12\operatorname{sigmoid}(a) m/s, where a a denotes the raw outputs. We recover positions using the fixed integration procedure in Appendix F.3 . The readout loss sums position and speed MSE, after scaling position errors by 20 m and speed errors by 5 m/s. We train for 16,000 AdamW steps with batch size 128, learning rate 0.002 and weight decay 0.01.

paragraphs.en: Our implementation averages over coordinates and projected samples. The regularizer weights therefore absorb normalization factors that appear in norm-based expressions of VISReg. We use J = 128 J=128 , λ center = 1 \lambda_{\rm center}=1 and λ scale = 10 \lambda_{\rm scale}=10 ; λ shape \lambda_{\rm shape} increases linearly from zero to one over the first 100 iterations. All priors use these same weights and schedule, with the original VISReg component functions. Only the standard deviation in the shape normalization is detached; the scale term still differentiates through s s . Both observation and target encoder branches receive gradients from representation regularization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实现对坐标和投影样本取平均。 因此，正则化权重吸收了 VISReg 基于范数的表达式中出现的归一化因子。 我们使用 J = 128 J=128、λ center = 1 \lambda_{\rm center}=1 和 λ scale = 10 \lambda_{\rm scale}=10；λ shape \lambda_{\rm shape} 在前 100 次迭代中从零线性增加到一。 所有先验均使用这些相同的权重与调度，并采用原始的 VISReg 分量函数。 只有形状归一化中的标准差被detach（不参与梯度）；尺度项仍然通过 s s 进行微分。 观测分支和目标编码器分支都接收来自表示正则化的梯度。

sents.en: Our implementation averages over coordinates and projected samples.
sents.zh: 我们的实现对坐标和投影样本取平均。

sents.en: The regularizer weights therefore absorb normalization factors that appear in norm-based expressions of VISReg.
sents.zh: 因此，正则化权重吸收了 VISReg 基于范数的表达式中出现的归一化因子。

sents.en: We use J = 128 J=128 , λ center = 1 \lambda_{\rm center}=1 and λ scale = 10 \lambda_{\rm scale}=10 ; λ shape \lambda_{\rm shape} increases linearly from zero to one over the first 100 iterations.
sents.zh: 我们使用 J = 128 J=128、λ center = 1 \lambda_{\rm center}=1 和 λ scale = 10 \lambda_{\rm scale}=10；λ shape \lambda_{\rm shape} 在前 100 次迭代中从零线性增加到一。

sents.en: All priors use these same weights and schedule, with the original VISReg component functions.
sents.zh: 所有先验均使用这些相同的权重与调度，并采用原始的 VISReg 分量函数。

sents.en: Only the standard deviation in the shape normalization is detached; the scale term still differentiates through s s .
sents.zh: 只有形状归一化中的标准差被detach（不参与梯度）；尺度项仍然通过 s s 进行微分。

sents.en: Both observation and target encoder branches receive gradients from representation regularization.
sents.zh: 观测分支和目标编码器分支都接收来自表示正则化的梯度。

paragraphs.en: Classical priors use the leave-one-out score-function update in Eq. 13 . For each sampled code, this update combines its predictive cost with the gradient of its log probability. When an observation has several target futures, we average the prediction–target distance over those futures. Each classical prior computes the code log probability using its own parameterization.
paragraphs.zh: 经典先验使用式 13 中的留一法得分函数更新。 对于每个采样的代码，该更新将其预测代价与其对数概率的梯度相结合。 当一个观测有多个目标未来时，我们对这些未来上的预测–目标距离取平均。 每个经典先验使用其自身的参数化来计算代码的对数概率。

sents.en: Classical priors use the leave-one-out score-function update in Eq. 13 .
sents.zh: 经典先验使用式 13 中的留一法得分函数更新。

sents.en: For each sampled code, this update combines its predictive cost with the gradient of its log probability.
sents.zh: 对于每个采样的代码，该更新将其预测代价与其对数概率的梯度相结合。

sents.en: When an observation has several target futures, we average the prediction–target distance over those futures.
sents.zh: 当一个观测有多个目标未来时，我们对这些未来上的预测–目标距离取平均。

sents.en: Each classical prior computes the code log probability using its own parameterization.
sents.zh: 每个经典先验使用其自身的参数化来计算代码的对数概率。

paragraphs.en: The ideal-gradient QCBM reference uses the same sampled-cost update, but differentiates Born log probabilities through the simulator. Gradients reach the classical conditioner, body-angle offsets and terminal rotation angles. These references still sample codes for the predictive objective; they do not enumerate predictions for every possible code. The trainable QCBMs in Tables 2 , 3 and 4 replace this simulator gradient with the measurement-based update in Section 3.4 . Ideal-gradient circuit comparisons and earlier D3IL ablations are identified separately in their respective appendices.
paragraphs.zh: 理想梯度 QCBM 参考实现使用相同的采样代价更新，但通过模拟器对 Born 对数概率求导。 梯度传递到经典条件器、身体角度偏移以及末端旋转角度。 这些参考实现仍然为预测目标采样编码；它们不会为每种可能的编码枚举预测。 表 2、3 和 4 中的可训练 QCBM 将这种模拟器梯度替换为第 3.4 节中基于测量的更新。 理想梯度电路比较以及早期的 D3IL 消融实验分别在各自的附录中单独标明。

sents.en: The ideal-gradient QCBM reference uses the same sampled-cost update, but differentiates Born log probabilities through the simulator.
sents.zh: 理想梯度 QCBM 参考实现使用相同的采样代价更新，但通过模拟器对 Born 对数概率求导。

sents.en: Gradients reach the classical conditioner, body-angle offsets and terminal rotation angles.
sents.zh: 梯度传递到经典条件器、身体角度偏移以及末端旋转角度。

sents.en: These references still sample codes for the predictive objective; they do not enumerate predictions for every possible code.
sents.zh: 这些参考实现仍然为预测目标采样编码；它们不会为每种可能的编码枚举预测。

sents.en: The trainable QCBMs in Tables 2 , 3 and 4 replace this simulator gradient with the measurement-based update in Section 3.4 .
sents.zh: 表 2、3 和 4 中的可训练 QCBM 将这种模拟器梯度替换为第 3.4 节中基于测量的更新。

sents.en: Ideal-gradient circuit comparisons and earlier D3IL ablations are identified separately in their respective appendices.
sents.zh: 理想梯度电路比较以及早期的 D3IL 消融实验分别在各自的附录中单独标明。

paragraphs.en: The prior affects both the target-fit term and the pairwise diversity term in the energy score. To see the resulting derivative, write a discrete objective as a ⊤ ​ p + p ⊤ ​ B ​ p a^{\top}p+p^{\top}Bp , with probability vector p p and symmetric matrix B B . Here a a contains prediction–target distances, while B B contains the negative half-distances between pairs of predictions. The derivative with respect to p p is a + 2 ​ B ​ p a+2Bp , giving Eq. 11 after substituting the energy terms. This explains why the prior’s cost uses the full pairwise-distance expectation, even though the energy loss contains a factor of one half. This vector notation explains the derivative; our sampled update does not construct these probability or distance tables.
paragraphs.zh: 先验同时影响能量得分中的目标契合项和成对多样性项。 为了看清由此产生的导数，可将离散目标写为 a^{\top}p+p^{\top}Bp，其中 p 为概率向量，B 为对称矩阵。 其中 a 包含预测与目标之间的距离，而 B 包含各对预测之间距离的负二分之一。 对 p 的导数为 a+2Bp，代入能量项后即得式 11。 这解释了为什么先验的代价使用完整的成对距离期望，尽管能量损失中含有一个二分之一的因子。 这种向量记法解释了导数的来源；我们的采样式更新并不会构造这些概率表或距离表。

paragraphs.en: The leave-one-out estimate in Eq. 13 compares each sample with the other K − 1 K-1 predictions, excluding its self-pair. For the prior update, we detach this cost and differentiate only the sampled code’s log probability. Classical priors and ideal-gradient QCBM references use this estimator. The reference QCBMs in Tables 2 and 3 instead use shifted-circuit measurements to estimate the same prior derivative through Eq. 14 .
paragraphs.zh: 式 13 中的留一估计将每个样本与其他 K−1 个预测进行比较，排除其自身配对。 对于先验更新，我们将该代价分离（detach），仅对采样代码的对数概率求导。 经典先验和理想梯度 QCBM 参考实现使用该估计器。 表 2 和表 3 中的参考 QCBM 则改用移位电路测量，通过式 14 估计相同的先验导数。

sents.en: The leave-one-out estimate in Eq. 13 compares each sample with the other K − 1 K-1 predictions, excluding its self-pair.
sents.zh: 式 13 中的留一估计将每个样本与其他 K−1 个预测进行比较，排除其自身配对。

sents.en: For the prior update, we detach this cost and differentiate only the sampled code’s log probability.
sents.zh: 对于先验更新，我们将该代价分离（detach），仅对采样代码的对数概率求导。

sents.en: Classical priors and ideal-gradient QCBM references use this estimator.
sents.zh: 经典先验和理想梯度 QCBM 参考实现使用该估计器。

paragraphs.en: During parameter shift, we hold the reference predictions fixed and evaluate the cost under positive and negative angle shifts. Independent reference and shifted samples give the population derivative in expectation. The pairwise term depends on two draws from the prior. Holding one reference distribution fixed lets the shifted circuits estimate the derivative through the other draw. The factor of two in the cost accounts for both draws’ dependence on the prior. For the RY/CNOT reference, we uniformly select r r of the G = n ⁡ ( L + 1 ) G=n(L+1) rotation coordinates and b b of the B B observations in a batch. The factors G / r G/r and B / b B/b correct for the coordinates and observations that were not evaluated. Table 5 gives the subsampling and shot budgets used for each task.
paragraphs.zh: 在参数移位过程中，我们保持参考预测固定，并在正、负角度移位下评估代价。 独立的参考样本和移位样本在期望上给出总体导数。 成对项依赖于从先验中抽取的两个样本。 保持其中一个参考分布固定，可以让移位后的线路通过另一次抽取来估计导数。 代价中的因子 2 考虑了两次抽取对先验的依赖。 对于 RY/CNOT 参考，我们从 G = n(L+1) 个旋转坐标中均匀选取 r 个，并从一批 B 个观测中均匀选取 b 个。 因子 G/r 和 B/b 用于校正未被评估的坐标和观测。 表 5 给出了每个任务所使用的子采样和测量次数预算。

sents.zh: 在参数移位过程中，我们保持参考预测固定，并在正、负角度移位下评估代价。

sents.zh: 成对项依赖于从先验中抽取的两个样本。

sents.zh: 保持其中一个参考分布固定，可以让移位后的线路通过另一次抽取来估计导数。

sents.en: For the RY/CNOT reference, we uniformly select r r of the G = n ⁡ ( L + 1 ) G=n(L+1) rotation coordinates and b b of the B B observations in a batch.
sents.zh: 对于 RY/CNOT 参考，我们从 G = n(L+1) 个旋转坐标中均匀选取 r 个，并从一批 B 个观测中均匀选取 b 个。

sents.en: The factors G / r G/r and B / b B/b correct for the coordinates and observations that were not evaluated.
sents.zh: 因子 G/r 和 B/b 用于校正未被评估的坐标和观测。

sents.en: Table 5 gives the subsampling and shot budgets used for each task.
sents.zh: 表 5 给出了每个任务所使用的子采样和测量次数预算。

paragraphs.en: Once the warm-up stages are complete, each world-model iteration proceeds as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 一旦预热阶段完成，每次世界模型迭代将按如下方式进行：

paragraphs.en: We draw a batch of observations and their realized future views, then encode both with the shared encoder.
paragraphs.zh: 我们抽取一批观测及其实现后的未来视角，然后用共享编码器对二者进行编码。

paragraphs.en: We sample K K actions per observation and predict one future representation for each sampled action.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每个观测采样 K K 个动作，并为每个采样的动作预测一个未来表征。

paragraphs.en: We compute predictive energy with the target representations detached, and representation regularization with both encoder branches trainable. For HEP18, we also regularize the change representations as specified in Appendix F.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在目标表征被截断梯度的情况下计算预测能量，并在两个编码器分支均可训练的情况下计算表征正则化。 对于 HEP18，我们还按照附录 F.3 中的说明对变化表征进行正则化。

sents.en: We compute predictive energy with the target representations detached, and representation regularization with both encoder branches trainable.
sents.zh: 我们在目标表征被截断梯度的情况下计算预测能量，并在两个编码器分支均可训练的情况下计算表征正则化。

sents.en: For HEP18, we also regularize the change representations as specified in Appendix F.3 .
sents.zh: 对于 HEP18，我们还按照附录 F.3 中的说明对变化表征进行正则化。

paragraphs.en: We compute a separate prior gradient, using parameter shift for QCBMs or the score-function estimator for classical priors. This update changes the prior only; it holds the encoded observations, targets and predictor fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分别计算先验的梯度，对于QCBM使用参数移位方法，对于经典先验则使用得分函数估计器。 此更新仅改变先验；编码后的观测、目标和预测器均保持固定。

sents.en: We compute a separate prior gradient, using parameter shift for QCBMs or the score-function estimator for classical priors.
sents.zh: 我们分别计算先验的梯度，对于QCBM使用参数移位方法，对于经典先验则使用得分函数估计器。

sents.en: This update changes the prior only; it holds the encoded observations, targets and predictor fixed.
sents.zh: 此更新仅改变先验；编码后的观测、目标和预测器均保持固定。

paragraphs.en: We combine the gradients for each parameter group, clip its norm at 5, and take an AdamW step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每个参数组合并梯度，将范数裁剪至 5，并执行一次 AdamW 更新步骤。

paragraphs.en: Iterations 1–200 train the encoder using only representation regularization. Iterations 201–300 also train the predictor, while retaining the initialized prior. Later iterations update all trainable groups; frozen-prior controls continue to omit prior updates. After world-model training, we freeze all JEPA parameters for readout training and evaluation. We use the final checkpoints, without selecting them by test performance.
paragraphs.zh: 第 1–200 次迭代仅使用表征正则化来训练编码器。 第 201–300 次迭代还训练预测器，同时保留初始化的先验。 后续迭代更新所有可训练的参数组；冻结先验的对照组仍不更新先验。 世界模型训练完成后，我们冻结所有 JEPA 参数，用于读出训练与评估。 我们使用最终的检查点，而不依据测试性能进行挑选。

sents.en: Iterations 1–200 train the encoder using only representation regularization.
sents.zh: 第 1–200 次迭代仅使用表征正则化来训练编码器。

sents.en: Iterations 201–300 also train the predictor, while retaining the initialized prior.
sents.zh: 第 201–300 次迭代还训练预测器，同时保留初始化的先验。

sents.en: Later iterations update all trainable groups; frozen-prior controls continue to omit prior updates.
sents.zh: 后续迭代更新所有可训练的参数组；冻结先验的对照组仍不更新先验。

sents.en: After world-model training, we freeze all JEPA parameters for readout training and evaluation.
sents.zh: 世界模型训练完成后，我们冻结所有 JEPA 参数，用于读出训练与评估。

sents.en: We use the final checkpoints, without selecting them by test performance.
sents.zh: 我们使用最终的检查点，而不依据测试性能进行挑选。

paragraphs.en: We use 96 public human demonstrations of the D3IL Avoiding task, recorded in a simulated obstacle course ( Jia et al., 2024 ) . Each of three route-stratified folds assigns 64 complete demonstrations to training and 32 to evaluation. Route labels are used only to construct these splits and evaluate predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用96段D3IL避障任务的公开人类示范，这些示范是在模拟障碍赛道中录制的（Jia et al., 2024）。 三个按路线分层的折中，每一折都将64条完整示范分配给训练，32条分配给评估。 路线标签仅用于构建这些划分并评估预测结果。

sents.en: We use 96 public human demonstrations of the D3IL Avoiding task, recorded in a simulated obstacle course ( Jia et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 我们使用96段D3IL避障任务的公开人类示范，这些示范是在模拟障碍赛道中录制的（Jia et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Each of three route-stratified folds assigns 64 complete demonstrations to training and 32 to evaluation.
sents.zh: 三个按路线分层的折中，每一折都将64条完整示范分配给训练，32条分配给评估。

sents.en: Route labels are used only to construct these splits and evaluate predictions.
sents.zh: 路线标签仅用于构建这些划分并评估预测结果。

paragraphs.en: We construct the first training observation by interpolating recorded frames 4–8 to 24 points. For subsequent predictions, the observation is the preceding segment. We divide futures into 8 cm arc-length segments, each resampled to 24 points, retaining shorter final segments and excluding padding. This gives 1,030 segments from the 96 source demonstrations. Coordinates are normalized as ( xy − ( 0.5 , − 0.28 ) ) / 0.4 (\mathrm{xy}-(0.5,-0.28))/0.4 ; evaluation restores metres. Training and evaluation use separate demonstrations within each fold.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过将录制的第 4–8 帧插值到 24 个点来构建第一条训练观测。 对于后续预测，观测即为前一段。 我们将未来轨迹划分为 8 厘米弧长的片段，每段重采样为 24 个点，保留较短的末段并排除填充。 这样从 96 条源演示中得到 1,030 个片段。 坐标按 ( xy − ( 0.5 , − 0.28 ) ) / 0.4 (\mathrm{xy}-(0.5,-0.28))/0.4 进行归一化；评估时恢复为米。 每一折内训练与评估使用各自独立的演示。

sents.en: We construct the first training observation by interpolating recorded frames 4–8 to 24 points.
sents.zh: 我们通过将录制的第 4–8 帧插值到 24 个点来构建第一条训练观测。

sents.en: For subsequent predictions, the observation is the preceding segment.
sents.zh: 对于后续预测，观测即为前一段。

sents.en: We divide futures into 8 cm arc-length segments, each resampled to 24 points, retaining shorter final segments and excluding padding.
sents.zh: 我们将未来轨迹划分为 8 厘米弧长的片段，每段重采样为 24 个点，保留较短的末段并排除填充。

sents.en: This gives 1,030 segments from the 96 source demonstrations.
sents.zh: 这样从 96 条源演示中得到 1,030 个片段。

sents.en: Coordinates are normalized as ( xy − ( 0.5 , − 0.28 ) ) / 0.4 (\mathrm{xy}-(0.5,-0.28))/0.4 ; evaluation restores metres.
Training and evaluation use separate demonstrations within each fold.
sents.zh: 每一折内训练与评估使用各自独立的演示。

paragraphs.en: The shared encoder forms seven-dimensional tokens from position, first and second differences, and a normalized sequence index. A linear layer, layer normalization and SiLU map tokens to width 128, followed by a width-128 GRU. Its final and mean states are concatenated and projected to 64 dimensions. A parallel → → 64 16\!\rightarrow\!128\!\rightarrow\!64 SiLU MLP encodes kinematic summaries: final displacement; displacement mean and standard deviation; first-difference mean, standard deviation and final value; and second-difference mean and standard deviation. Each quantity has two coordinates. We add this branch to the GRU output.
paragraphs.zh: 共享编码器由位置、一阶差分和二阶差分以及归一化的序列索引构成七维词元。 一个线性层、层归一化和 SiLU 将词元映射到宽度 128，随后接一个宽度为 128 的 GRU。 其最终状态与均值状态被拼接并投影到 64 维。 一个并行的 → → 64 16\!\rightarrow\!128\!\rightarrow\!64 的 SiLU MLP 对运动学摘要进行编码：最终位移；位移的均值和标准差；一阶差分的均值、标准差和最终值；以及二阶差分的均值和标准差。 每个量有两个坐标。 我们将该分支加到 GRU 的输出上。

sents.en: The shared encoder forms seven-dimensional tokens from position, first and second differences, and a normalized sequence index.
sents.zh: 共享编码器由位置、一阶差分和二阶差分以及归一化的序列索引构成七维词元。

sents.en: A linear layer, layer normalization and SiLU map tokens to width 128, followed by a width-128 GRU.
sents.zh: 一个线性层、层归一化和 SiLU 将词元映射到宽度 128，随后接一个宽度为 128 的 GRU。

paragraphs.en: Next, we freeze the JEPA and train the readout on encoded real targets with Smooth L1 coordinate loss. We use 8,000 steps at learning rate 0.002 and 2,000 at 0.0002. Batch size is 64, AdamW weight decay is 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and gradient norms are clipped at five. Finally, we freeze encoder and readout and train predictor and prior for 1,000 steps at rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} . Sixteen real three-segment windows provide 48 local observation–future pairs per batch. The same energy and prior updates apply; quantum gradients select eight pairs under the same measurement settings. This last stage trains on recorded segment pairs rather than generated rollouts. The training objective contains no obstacle penalties.

paragraphs.en: Frozen-QCBM fixes the entire initialized prior throughout both predictive stages. Its zero-initialized conditioner output remains zero, so its distribution is input-independent; the predictor still receives the observation. The trainable QCBMs have 11,700 initial and 1,000 final prior updates, consuming 1,277,824,000 simulated training shots per run. Frozen-QCBM uses 26,112,000 forward shots without shifts. These shot counts cover training in the simulator and exclude evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: Frozen-QCBM 在两个预测阶段中始终固定整个初始化的先验分布。 其零初始化的条件器输出保持为零，因此其分布与输入无关；预测器仍会接收观测值。 可训练的 QCBM 具有 11,700 次初始和 1,000 次最终先验更新，每次运行消耗 1,277,824,000 个模拟训练快照。 Frozen-QCBM 使用 26,112,000 个前向快照且无需移位。 这些快照数量涵盖在模拟器中的训练，但不包括评估。

paragraphs.en: Entangled-QCBM has four RY/CNOT body layers and terminal RY rotations: forty rotations and fourteen CNOTs. Even-indexed layers couple ( 0 , 1 ) , ( 2 , 3 ) , … (0,1),(2,3),\ldots ; odd-indexed layers couple ( 1 , 2 ) , ( 3 , 4 ) , … (1,2),(3,4),\ldots , with lower-index controls. The conditioner has widths → → 32 64\!\rightarrow\!48\!\rightarrow\!32 . Product-QCBM removes CNOTs; Frozen-QCBM fixes the entangled initialization. AR-GRU uses the common width-48 prior in Appendix A ; Mixture-4 has four Bernoulli components, and Softmax-Categorical has 256 logits. All six sampled priors share the encoder, predictor, readout and schedule. Deterministic JEPA fixes the code to zero and uses representation MSE; it retains the final predictor-only training stage.

A residual → → 64 76\!\rightarrow\!128\!\rightarrow\!64 transition predicts features. Its objective combines target-feature MSE, dimension-averaged Gaussian KL with weight one, and the same two-view VISReg. It uses 13,000 Adam updates at a fixed learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , followed by the common 10,000-step readout fit. The posterior’s 19,608 parameters are used only during training.

paragraphs.en: All 96 raw trajectories have exactly the same starting point, approximately ( 0.52492847 , − 0.27973673 ) (0.52492847,-0.27973673) m. For evaluation, we repeat that point 24 times, giving no observed motion or heading. Sequence indices supply token order only. We encode this observation, sample a code, predict and decode a segment, then re-encode its coordinates before the next call. Generation stops when the trajectory first crosses y = 0.35 y=0.35 m or after sixteen calls. We interpolate the endpoint at the crossing. Every trajectory starts directly from the stationary point. paragraphs.en: A path is accepted only if it reaches the goal, crosses every obstacle row, avoids all inflated obstacles and stays within the geometric reach envelope. We include starting and inter-segment connections and the final partial edge in continuous collision checks. Obstacle radii add 1 cm for the manipulator tip; the reach bound is approximately 1.0913 m with tolerance 10 − 6 10^{-6} m. paragraphs.en: Each of the nine models per method supplies three 128-path repetitions, forming a 384-raw-path pool. All stochastic pools have at least 61 accepted paths; one Latent-CVAE pool has fewer than 64. We therefore use a common 60-accepted-path budget, without replenishing pools or discarding checkpoints. We compute expected coverage and TV over uniformly drawn 60-path subsets. The route counts follow a hypergeometric distribution, allowing exact expectations without repeated subsampling. No route balancing or nearest-target selection is applied. Six deterministic models have no accepted paths; the other three repeat one accepted route. We therefore report the aggregate deterministic TV as undefined.
paragraphs.zh: 每种方法的九个模型各提供三次 128 条路径的重复采样，形成 384 条原始路径的池。 所有随机池均有至少 61 条被接受的路径；仅有一个 Latent-CVAE 池少于 64 条。 因此，我们采用统一的 60 条被接受路径的预算，既不补充池，也不丢弃检查点。 我们在均匀抽取的 60 条路径子集上计算期望覆盖率和总变差（TV）。 路径数量服从超几何分布，因此无需重复子采样即可精确计算期望值。 未采用任何路径均衡或最近目标选择。 六个确定性模型没有可接受的路径；另外三个模型则重复同一条可接受的路径。 因此，我们将确定性模型的总变差（TV）报告为未定义。

paragraphs.en: We average folds within each seed, then report the mean and sample standard deviation of the three seed-level means in Table 4 . paragraphs.en: For memory accounting, we distinguish allocated parameters from parameters used in the forward computation. The implementation allocates three body-angle coordinates per qubit and layer, but this ansatz uses only the Y Y coordinate. HEP18 therefore has 96 unused body-angle entries, and MovingMNIST has 12. All terminal angles are used in the forward computation. The shared code predictor also includes an agent-identity offset, including in the single-digit model.

paragraphs.en: At fixed numerical precision, weight storage follows the parameter counts in Table 1 . AR-GRU requires O ⁡ ( K ​ H p ) O(KH_{p}) recurrent-state storage when generating K K codes in parallel, with n n sequential decisions per code. A hardware QCBM uses n n qubits and O ⁡ ( n ​ L + H p ) O(nL+H_{p}) classical conditioner memory. Parallel two-qubit matchings give depth O ⁡ ( L ) O(L) per draw, assuming compatible hardware connectivity.

paragraphs.en: We compare three gradient-estimation settings for each QCBM family: ideal-gradient simulation, noise-free finite-shot parameter shift, and parameter shift with independent 0.5% readout flips per bit. The noisy setting supplies the Product-QCBM and Entangled-QCBM rows in the main tables, Tables 2 and 3 . Each setting uses three independent initializations, matched across settings, and we retain every training run. We keep the architecture, data, losses, iteration counts, readout training and 128-draw evaluation budget fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每个 QCBM 家族比较三种梯度估计设置：理想梯度模拟、无噪声有限采样次数的参数移位，以及每个比特独立发生 0.5% 读出翻转的参数移位。 噪声设置为正文表格（表 2 和表 3）中的 Product-QCBM 行和 Entangled-QCBM 行提供数据。 每种设置使用三个相互匹配的独立初始化，并且我们保留每一次训练运行。 我们保持架构、数据、损失、迭代次数、读出训练以及 128 次抽取的评估预算固定不变。

paragraphs.en: The two parameter-shift settings estimate gradients from measured bit strings rather than from differentiable simulated probabilities. In the noisy setting, the same readout-flip channel is active during both training and evaluation. Its results therefore reflect noise in both gradient estimation and prediction-time sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种参数移位设置是从测得的比特串而非可微的模拟概率来估计梯度的。 在含噪设置中，同一个读出翻转信道在训练和评估期间均处于激活状态。 因此，其结果同时反映了梯度估计和预测时采样中的噪声。

sents.en: The two parameter-shift settings estimate gradients from measured bit strings rather than from differentiable simulated probabilities.
sents.zh: 这两种参数移位设置是从测得的比特串而非可微的模拟概率来估计梯度的。

sents.en: In the noisy setting, the same readout-flip channel is active during both training and evaluation.
sents.zh: 在含噪设置中，同一个读出翻转信道在训练和评估期间均处于激活状态。

sents.en: Its results therefore reflect noise in both gradient estimation and prediction-time sampling.
sents.zh: 因此，其结果同时反映了梯度估计和预测时采样中的噪声。

paragraphs.en: For each selected observation and angle, we sample circuits with positive and negative π / 2 \pi/2 shifts. Each shifted circuit supplies 256 shots on MovingMNIST or 512 on HEP18. The 32 unshifted predictions provide the independent reference samples used to evaluate the shifted costs. Across the full training schedule, the recorded budgets are approximately 144.6 million shots per MovingMNIST model and 566.5 million per HEP18 model. These totals include both shifted measurements and unshifted training samples. The experiments establish a measurement-based route to training the prior; practical hardware training would also require reducing this sampling cost.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个选定的观测和角度，我们采样具有正负 \pi/2 移位的线路。 每个移位线路在 MovingMNIST 上提供 256 次测量，在 HEP18 上提供 512 次测量。 32 个未移位预测提供用于评估移位代价的独立参考样本。 在整个训练过程中，记录的预算约为每个 MovingMNIST 模型 1.446 亿次测量，每个 HEP18 模型 5.665 亿次测量。 这些总量包括移位测量和未移位训练样本。 这些实验建立了基于测量来训练先验的路径；实际的硬件训练还需要降低这种采样成本。

sents.en: For each selected observation and angle, we sample circuits with positive and negative π / 2 \pi/2 shifts.
sents.zh: 对于每个选定的观测和角度，我们采样具有正负 \pi/2 移位的线路。

sents.en: Each shifted circuit supplies 256 shots on MovingMNIST or 512 on HEP18.
sents.zh: 每个移位线路在 MovingMNIST 上提供 256 次测量，在 HEP18 上提供 512 次测量。

sents.en: The 32 unshifted predictions provide the independent reference samples used to evaluate the shifted costs.
sents.zh: 32 个未移位预测提供用于评估移位代价的独立参考样本。

sents.en: Across the full training schedule, the recorded budgets are approximately 144.6 million shots per MovingMNIST model and 566.5 million per HEP18 model.
sents.zh: 在整个训练过程中，记录的预算约为每个 MovingMNIST 模型 1.446 亿次测量，每个 HEP18 模型 5.665 亿次测量。

sents.en: These totals include both shifted measurements and unshifted training samples.
sents.zh: 这些总量包括移位测量和未移位训练样本。

sents.en: The experiments establish a measurement-based route to training the prior; practical hardware training would also require reducing this sampling cost.
sents.zh: 这些实验建立了基于测量来训练先验的路径；实际的硬件训练还需要降低这种采样成本。

paragraphs.en: Both circuit families retained high validity and similar frequency accuracy when trained with parameter shift. Some displayed means improved slightly over ideal-gradient training, but three runs do not establish a benefit from adding noise.
paragraphs.zh: 两类电路族在使用参数移位训练时均保持了较高的有效性以及相近的频率精度。 部分显示均值相比理想梯度训练略有提升，但三次运行并不足以证明加入噪声能带来收益。

sents.en: Both circuit families retained high validity and similar frequency accuracy when trained with parameter shift.
sents.zh: 两类电路族在使用参数移位训练时均保持了较高的有效性以及相近的频率精度。

sents.en: Some displayed means improved slightly over ideal-gradient training, but three runs do not establish a benefit from adding noise.
sents.zh: 部分显示均值相比理想梯度训练略有提升，但三次运行并不足以证明加入噪声能带来收益。

paragraphs.en: Noise-free parameter shift retained nearly complete coverage and similar trajectory errors for Entangled-QCBM. The noisy setting had mean joint validity of 93.38%, compared with 98.55% for the ideal-gradient reference. Its between-training standard deviation increased to 6.04 percentage points. The three noisy runs ranged from 86.41–97.09% validity, while each recovered more than 99% of the joint future modes.
paragraphs.zh: 无噪声参数偏移使纠缠-QCBM保持了几乎完全的覆盖率和相近的轨迹误差。 有噪声设置下的平均联合有效率为93.38%，而理想梯度参考为98.55%。 其训练间标准差增至6.04个百分点。 三次有噪声运行的有效率在86.41%–97.09%之间，而每次运行均恢复了超过99%的联合未来模式。

sents.en: Noise-free parameter shift retained nearly complete coverage and similar trajectory errors for Entangled-QCBM.
sents.zh: 无噪声参数偏移使纠缠-QCBM保持了几乎完全的覆盖率和相近的轨迹误差。

sents.en: The noisy setting had mean joint validity of 93.38%, compared with 98.55% for the ideal-gradient reference.
sents.zh: 有噪声设置下的平均联合有效率为93.38%，而理想梯度参考为98.55%。

sents.en: Its between-training standard deviation increased to 6.04 percentage points.
sents.zh: 其训练间标准差增至6.04个百分点。

sents.en: The three noisy runs ranged from 86.41–97.09% validity, while each recovered more than 99% of the joint future modes.
sents.zh: 三次有噪声运行的有效率在86.41%–97.09%之间，而每次运行均恢复了超过99%的联合未来模式。

paragraphs.en: Product-QCBM had substantially lower joint validity under all three training settings. Thus, Entangled-QCBM continued to learn useful cross-agent correlations when gradients were estimated from measurements. The noisy model nevertheless had lower mean validity than the strongest classical correlated priors in the main comparison.
paragraphs.zh: Product-QCBM 在全部三种训练设置下的联合有效性都显著更低。 因此，当梯度从测量中估计时，Entangled-QCBM 仍能继续学习有用的跨智能体相关性。 尽管如此，该噪声模型在主对比中的平均有效性仍低于最强的经典相关先验。

sents.en: Product-QCBM had substantially lower joint validity under all three training settings.
sents.zh: Product-QCBM 在全部三种训练设置下的联合有效性都显著更低。

sents.en: Thus, Entangled-QCBM continued to learn useful cross-agent correlations when gradients were estimated from measurements.
sents.zh: 因此，当梯度从测量中估计时，Entangled-QCBM 仍能继续学习有用的跨智能体相关性。

sents.zh: 尽管如此，该噪声模型在主对比中的平均有效性仍低于最强的经典相关先验。

paragraphs.en: These comparisons test different ways of learning a predictive distribution. They complement the prior comparisons in Section 5.1 , which keep our sampled predictive objective fixed. All models receive observations and realized futures, without action or mode labels. We retain the same benchmark encoder architectures and 64-dimensional representations. The external prediction networks use hidden width H = 96 H=96 for MovingMNIST and H = 64 H=64 for HEP18. For HEP18, the encoder concatenates four 16-dimensional agent representations. External predictors receive the complete observation representation; we do not impose our agent-local code restriction on these baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 这些比较测试了学习预测分布的不同方法。 它们与第 5.1 节中保持采样预测目标不变的先前比较互为补充。 所有模型接收观测和实现的未来，不含动作或模式标签。 我们保留相同的基准编码器架构和 64 维表示。 外部预测网络在 MovingMNIST 上使用隐藏宽度 H = 96，在 HEP18 上使用 H = 64。 对于 HEP18，编码器拼接四个 16 维的智能体表示。 外部预测器接收完整的观测表示；我们不将这些智能体局部代码限制强加于这些基线。

sents.zh: 这些比较测试了学习预测分布的不同方法。

sents.zh: 它们与第 5.1 节中保持采样预测目标不变的先前比较互为补充。

sents.zh: 对于 HEP18，编码器拼接四个 16 维的智能体表示。

paragraphs.en: We use the training objective from the authors’ public MovingMNIST visual implementation of Variational JEPA ( Huang, 2026 ) . An online encoder produces the observation representation h h . A second encoder, updated by exponential moving average (EMA), produces the target representation t t . Separate d → H → d d\!\rightarrow\!H\!\rightarrow\!d SiLU MLPs predict the mean μ ⁡ ( h ) \mu(h) and log variance ℓ ⁡ ( h ) \ell(h) of a Gaussian future representation. We clamp the predicted log variances to the range [ − 10 , 10 ] [-10,10] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用来自作者公开的 MovingMNIST 变分 JEPA 视觉实现（ Huang, 2026 ）的训练目标。 在线编码器生成观测表示 h h 。 第二个编码器通过指数移动平均（EMA）进行更新，生成目标表示 t t 。 独立的 d → H → d d\!\rightarrow\!H\!\rightarrow\!d SiLU 多层感知机预测高斯未来表示的均值 μ ⁡ ( h ) \mu(h) 和对数方差 ℓ ⁡ ( h ) \ell(h) 。 我们将预测的对数方差限制在范围 [ − 10 , 10 ] [-10,10] 内。

sents.en: We use the training objective from the authors’ public MovingMNIST visual implementation of Variational JEPA ( Huang, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 我们使用来自作者公开的 MovingMNIST 变分 JEPA 视觉实现（ Huang, 2026 ）的训练目标。

sents.en: An online encoder produces the observation representation h h .
sents.zh: 在线编码器生成观测表示 h h 。

sents.en: A second encoder, updated by exponential moving average (EMA), produces the target representation t t .
sents.zh: 第二个编码器通过指数移动平均（EMA）进行更新，生成目标表示 t t 。

sents.en: Separate d → H → d d\!\rightarrow\!H\!\rightarrow\!d SiLU MLPs predict the mean μ ⁡ ( h ) \mu(h) and log variance ℓ ⁡ ( h ) \ell(h) of a Gaussian future representation.
sents.zh: 独立的 d → H → d d\!\rightarrow\!H\!\rightarrow\!d SiLU 多层感知机预测高斯未来表示的均值 μ ⁡ ( h ) \mu(h) 和对数方差 ℓ ⁡ ( h ) \ell(h) 。

sents.en: We clamp the predicted log variances to the range [ − 10 , 10 ] [-10,10] .
sents.zh: 我们将预测的对数方差限制在范围 [ − 10 , 10 ] [-10,10] 内。

paragraphs.en: We train the mean prediction using VICReg between μ ⁡ ( h ) \mu(h) and the detached target. The MSE term has weight 25, each branch’s variance-hinge term has weight 25, and the off-diagonal covariance term has weight 1. The variance head uses the Gaussian calibration loss
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 VICReg 在 μ ⁡ ( h ) \mu(h) 与分离的目标之间训练均值预测。 MSE 项的权重为 25，每个分支的方差合页项的权重为 25，非对角协方差项的权重为 1。 方差头使用高斯校准损失。

sents.en: We train the mean prediction using VICReg between μ ⁡ ( h ) \mu(h) and the detached target.
sents.zh: 我们使用 VICReg 在 μ ⁡ ( h ) \mu(h) 与分离的目标之间训练均值预测。

sents.en: The MSE term has weight 25, each branch’s variance-hinge term has weight 25, and the off-diagonal covariance term has weight 1.
sents.zh: MSE 项的权重为 25，每个分支的方差合页项的权重为 25，非对角协方差项的权重为 1。

sents.en: The variance head uses the Gaussian calibration loss
sents.zh: 方差头使用高斯校准损失。

paragraphs.en: We give this term weight 0.1 and detach the observation representation, mean prediction and target when computing it. It therefore updates only the variance head, which learns the uncertainty around the mean prediction. At inference, we draw future representations from t ^ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( μ ⁡ ( h ) , diag ⁡ ( exp ⁡ ℓ ⁡ ( h ) ) ) \widehat{t}\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu(h),\operatorname{diag}(\exp\ell(h))) . This adaptation follows the visual implementation’s VICReg and variance-calibration training procedure, rather than reproducing every objective considered in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 我们给这一项赋予 0.1 的权重，并在计算时对观测表征、均值预测和目标进行梯度截断（detach）。 因此它只更新方差头，该头负责学习均值预测周围的不确定性。 在推理时，我们从 t ^ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( μ ⁡ ( h ) , diag ⁡ ( exp ⁡ ℓ ⁡ ( h ) ) ) \widehat{t}\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu(h),\operatorname{diag}(\exp\ell(h))) 中采样未来表征。 这一适配遵循视觉实现中的 VICReg 与方差校准训练流程，而非复现论文中考虑的每一个目标函数。

paragraphs.en: We use the benchmark-specific encoder and readout to accommodate each task’s input and output, replacing the original single-frame CNN. Training uses Adam with learning rate 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} and global gradient clipping at norm 5. We update the EMA encoder after every optimizer step, using coefficient 0.99 for MovingMNIST and 0.999 for HEP18. Development evaluation selected these settings from the two coefficients and the original once-per-pair-epoch update schedule. A pair epoch counts observation–future pairs, including all target views when a batch groups several futures under one observation. We train for 4,000 updates on MovingMNIST and 6,000 on HEP18, without test-selected early stopping.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用针对各基准任务定制的编码器（encoder）和读出层（readout）来适配每个任务的输入与输出，以替换原有的单帧 CNN。 训练使用 Adam，学习率为 5\times10^{-4}，并采用范数阈值为 5 的全局梯度裁剪。 我们在每次优化器更新之后更新 EMA 编码器，在 MovingMNIST 上使用系数 0.99，在 HEP18 上使用 0.999。 开发集评估从这两个系数以及原始的每对每周期更新一次的调度方式中选出了上述设置。 一个“对周期”统计的是观测—未来数据对的数量，当同一个观测在一个批次中对应多个未来序列时，会把所有目标视图都计入其中。 我们在 MovingMNIST 上训练 4,000 次更新，在 HEP18 上训练 6,000 次更新，不使用基于测试集的早停。

sents.en: A pair epoch counts observation–future pairs, including all target views when a batch groups several futures under one observation.
