paragraphs.en: For both baselines, we freeze the complete world model before fitting the benchmark-specific readout on encoded real futures. Variational JEPA supplies targets from its EMA encoder; Latent-CVAE uses its shared encoder. At inference, each readout decodes sampled predicted representations instead. We train readouts for 4,000 updates on MovingMNIST and 16,000 on HEP18. The data splits, decoded-output validity thresholds and sample counts match the within-framework comparisons. Each baseline is trained three times from independent initializations. Reported standard deviations describe variation across these trained models, not variation among a single model’s 128 draws.
paragraphs.zh: 对于两个基线，我们都先冻结完整的世界模型，再在编码后的真实未来上拟合针对基准任务的读出头。 变分JEPA由其EMA编码器提供目标；Latent-CVAE则使用其共享编码器。 在推断时，每个读出头改为对采样得到的预测表征进行解码。 我们在MovingMNIST上训练读出头4,000次更新，在HEP18上训练16,000次更新。 数据划分、解码输出有效性阈值和样本数量均与框架内对比实验保持一致。 每个基线均从独立初始化出发训练三次。 报告的标准差描述的是这些训练好的模型之间的差异，而非单一模型128次采样之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: Best-sample accuracy and distributional validity need not agree. Latent-CVAE has higher MovingMNIST coverage and lower minimum ADE, yet many draws fall between the valid directions. On HEP18, its energy score is close to ours despite much lower joint validity: incompatible agent combinations can still have moderate average trajectory error. Variational JEPA also has low joint validity, although its readout accurately decodes encoded real targets, pointing to errors in predicted features rather than target reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 最佳样本精度与分布有效性无需一致。 Latent-CVAE 在 MovingMNIST 上覆盖率更高且最小 ADE 更低，但许多采样结果落在有效方向之间。 在 HEP18 上，尽管其联合有效性低得多，其能量分数却与我们的接近：不兼容的智能体组合仍可能具有中等的平均轨迹误差。 变分 JEPA 的联合有效性也很低，尽管其读出网络能准确解码编码的真实目标，这表明错误出在预测特征而非目标重建上。

paragraphs.en: For MovingMNIST and HEP18, we evaluate three independent training runs per method, using 128 prior draws per observation and retaining repeated codes. Deterministic JEPA repeats its single continuation 128 times under the same metrics. The trained QCBMs use noisy parameter shift; Frozen-QCBM keeps its initialized, noise-free prior. D3IL’s distinct training and aggregation protocol is specified in Appendix B . Table shading identifies trained QCBMs; bold and underlined entries mark the best and second-best displayed means, not statistical significance.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 MovingMNIST 和 HEP18，我们对每种方法评估三次独立的训练运行，每次观测使用 128 个先验采样并保留重复编码。 确定性 JEPA 在相同指标下将其单一延续重复 128 次。 训练后的 QCBM 使用含噪参数移位；Frozen-QCBM 保留其初始化的无噪声先验。 D3IL 独特的训练与聚合协议在附录 B 中说明。 表格阴影标识训练后的 QCBM；加粗和下划线条目标记显示的最优和次优均值，而非统计显著性。

paragraphs.en: In the noisy setting, we independently flip each measured bit with probability 0.005, during both training and evaluation. The noise-free parameter-shift reference uses the same procedure without these flips. This noise model covers readout flips only; it does not include gate errors, decoherence or device-specific calibration noise.
paragraphs.zh: 在含噪声设置中，我们在训练和评估阶段都以 0.005 的概率对每个测量比特进行独立翻转。 无噪声的参数移位参考采用相同流程，但不进行这些翻转。 该噪声模型仅涵盖读出翻转；不包含门错误、退相干或设备特定的校准噪声。

paragraphs.en: We construct single-digit videos from MNIST sprites using the MovingMNIST setting ( Srivastava et al., 2015 ) . Each observation contains three 64 × 64 64\times 64 frames showing the same digit moving horizontally. The digit centre passes through x = 18 , 21 , 24 x=18,21,24 pixels at a fixed vertical coordinate drawn uniformly from integers 24–40. Each future contains three more frames, with a displacement of four pixels per frame. The future direction is one of eight angles, separated by 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} and starting from horizontal rightward motion in image coordinates. The four cardinal directions each have probability 0.15; the four diagonal directions each have probability 0.10. A separate digit-dependent probability experiment appears in Appendix I ; it does not replace this reference task.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 MovingMNIST 设置（Srivastava et al., 2015）从 MNIST 图像精灵构建单数字视频。 每个观测包含三帧 64 × 64 64\times 64 的画面，显示同一个数字水平移动。 数字中心在固定垂直坐标下经过 x = 18 , 21 , 24 x=18,21,24 像素位置，该垂直坐标从 24–40 的整数中均匀抽取。 每个未来包含另外三帧，每帧位移为四个像素。 未来方向是八个角度之一，彼此间隔 45 ∘ 45^{\circ}，从图像坐标系中水平向右运动开始。 四个基元方向各有 0.15 的概率；四个对角方向各有 0.10 的概率。 一个独立的依赖数字的概率实验见附录 I；它不取代该参考任务。

paragraphs.en: We use 800 training observations from MNIST’s training split and 80 test observations from its test split. We reserve another 80 observations from the MNIST training split for development, disjoint from the 800 fitting observations. Development first checks readout viability and then compares decoded trajectory energy score; the official test split is not used for this selection. Each training observation has 20 records in permuted order, comprising three continuations per cardinal direction and two per diagonal direction. These frequencies implement the specified 0.15 and 0.10 direction probabilities. Each training example supplies the observation images and one realized future clip. Direction labels, centre coordinates and the list of possible futures are used only for evaluation, not as model inputs. The three-bit register provides eight possible codes, whose effects on motion are learned. Multiple codes may learn similar continuations; we do not impose a one-to-one assignment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用MNIST训练集划分中的800个训练观测，以及测试集划分中的80个测试观测。 我们另外从MNIST训练集划分中保留80个观测用于开发，这80个观测与用于拟合的800个观测互不重叠。 开发阶段首先检验读出机制的可行性，然后比较解码轨迹的能量得分；官方测试集划分不用于这一选择过程。 每个训练观测包含20条按置换顺序排列的记录，其中包括每个基数方向各3条延续和每个对角方向各2条延续。 这些频率实现了指定的0.15和0.10方向概率。 每个训练样本提供观测图像以及一个实际发生的未来片段。 方向标签、中心坐标和可能未来列表仅用于评估，不作为模型输入。 三比特寄存器提供八种可能的编码，它们对运动的影响通过学习获得。 多个编码可能学习到相似的延续；我们不强制一一对应的分配关系。

sents.en: Each training example supplies the observation images and one realized future clip.
sents.zh: 每个训练样本提供观测图像以及一个实际发生的未来片段。

sents.en: Direction labels, centre coordinates and the list of possible futures are used only for evaluation, not as model inputs.
sents.zh: 方向标签、中心坐标和可能未来列表仅用于评估，不作为模型输入。

sents.en: The three-bit register provides eight possible codes, whose effects on motion are learned.
sents.zh: 三比特寄存器提供八种可能的编码，它们对运动的影响通过学习获得。

sents.en: Multiple codes may learn similar continuations; we do not impose a one-to-one assignment.
sents.zh: 多个编码可能学习到相似的延续；我们不强制一一对应的分配关系。

paragraphs.en: The target probabilities can be represented by independent bits under a suitable learned assignment of codes to directions. One bit with probability 0.6 and two fair bits give four code probabilities of 0.15 and four of 0.10. We do not provide this assignment to the model during training. The benchmark therefore tests whether the model learns distinct futures and their frequencies; it does not require entanglement.
paragraphs.zh: 在对方向进行合适的编码分配学习后，目标概率可以用相互独立的比特来表示。 一个概率为 0.6 的比特加上两个公平比特，会给出四个 0.15 的编码概率和四个 0.10 的编码概率。 我们在训练过程中不会向模型提供这种编码分配。 因此，该基准测试考察的是模型能否学到不同的未来及其出现频率；它并不要求纠缠。

paragraphs.en: The shared encoder maps each three-frame clip to a representation. The predictor combines the observation representation with a three-bit action to predict a future representation. Appendix A.2 specifies the encoder, predictor and readout architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 共享编码器将每个三帧片段映射为一个表示。 预测器将观测表示与一个三比特动作相结合，以预测未来的表示。 附录 A.2 规定了编码器、预测器和读出模块的架构。

sents.en: The shared encoder maps each three-frame clip to a representation.
sents.zh: 共享编码器将每个三帧片段映射为一个表示。

sents.en: The predictor combines the observation representation with a three-bit action to predict a future representation.
sents.zh: 预测器将观测表示与一个三比特动作相结合，以预测未来的表示。

sents.en: Appendix A.2 specifies the encoder, predictor and readout architectures.
sents.zh: 附录 A.2 规定了编码器、预测器和读出模块的架构。

paragraphs.en: We train the image readout after freezing the encoder, predictor and prior. During readout training, its input is the concatenation of the observation and target representations, [ h ; t ] [h;t] . At inference, we replace the encoded target with the predicted representation and supply [ h ; t ^ ] [h;\widehat{t}] instead. The readout predicts one two-dimensional displacement for each future frame. A bilinear spatial transformer shifts the last observed image by these displacements to produce the future clip.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在冻结编码器、预测器和先验之后训练图像读出模块。 在读出模块训练期间，其输入是观测表示与目标表示的拼接，[ h ; t ] [h;t] 。 在推理时，我们用预测的表示替换编码后的目标，并改为输入 [ h ; t ^ ] [h;\widehat{t}] 。 读出模块为每个未来帧预测一个二维位移。 一个双线性空间变换器根据这些位移平移最后观测到的图像，从而生成未来的视频片段。

sents.zh: 我们在冻结编码器、预测器和先验之后训练图像读出模块。

sents.en: During readout training, its input is the concatenation of the observation and target representations, [ h ; t ] [h;t] .

sents.zh: 在推理时，我们用预测的表示替换编码后的目标，并改为输入 [ h ; t ^ ] [h;\widehat{t}] 。

sents.en: The readout predicts one two-dimensional displacement for each future frame.
sents.zh: 读出模块为每个未来帧预测一个二维位移。

sents.en: A bilinear spatial transformer shifts the last observed image by these displacements to produce the future clip.
sents.zh: 一个双线性空间变换器根据这些位移平移最后观测到的图像，从而生成未来的视频片段。

paragraphs.en: This design uses the benchmark’s translation structure, so the learned readout estimates motion rather than synthesizing digit appearance from scratch. Its image loss updates only the readout, leaving all JEPA parameters fixed. Every method uses the same readout architecture, training budget and target-feature training procedure, detailed in Appendix A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 该设计采用了基准的翻译结构，因此所学习的读出估计的是运动，而不是从零开始合成数字的外观。 其图像损失仅更新读出，所有JEPA参数保持固定。 每种方法都使用相同的读出架构、训练预算和目标特征训练流程，详见附录A.2。

paragraphs.en: We construct HEP18 on the straight intersection lanes of HighwayEnv ( Leurent, 2018 ) , with four approaching vehicles and 18 possible joint futures. The vehicles approach the intersection from north, west, south and east. For each vehicle, we sample its initial speed uniformly over [ 8 , 9 ] [8,9] m/s and its distance from the centre over [ 43 , 47 ] [43,47] m. The observation records two seconds of motion at these constant speeds. The future spans nine seconds, divided into three stages of three seconds each. Within each stage, acceleration is constant and we integrate the motion exactly. We use HighwayEnv’s road geometry with these specified motion schedules, rather than its default driver policy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 HighwayEnv（Leurent, 2018）的直行交叉车道上构建 HEP18，包含四辆接近的车辆和 18 种可能的联合未来。 这些车辆分别从北、西、南、东四个方向驶向交叉路口。 对于每辆车，我们将其初始速度在 [8, 9] m/s 内均匀采样，将其与路口中心的距离在 [43, 47] m 内均匀采样。 观测记录了车辆以这些恒定速度运动的两秒钟。 未来跨度为九秒，分为三个阶段，每阶段三秒。 在每个阶段内，加速度保持恒定，我们对运动进行精确积分。 我们使用 HighwayEnv 的道路几何结构并采用这些指定的运动方案，而不是其默认的驾驶策略。

paragraphs.en: The dataset contains 448 observations, with 256 for training, 64 for validation and 128 for testing. We split by observation, keeping all 18 associated futures together. We choose the final HEP18 training configuration using only the 64 validation observations. Each final checkpoint is then evaluated on the separate 128-observation test split, without further parameter updates.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集包含448个观测，其中256个用于训练，64个用于验证，128个用于测试。 我们按观测进行划分，将所有18个相关未来数据保持在一起。 我们仅使用64个验证观测来选择最终的HEP18训练配置。 每个最终检查点随后在单独的128个观测的测试划分上进行评估，且不进行进一步的参数更新。

paragraphs.en: The same per-agent encoder maps both views to local representations. We concatenate the four agent representations to describe the complete scene. The predictor learns a residual change in these learned representation coordinates. Training uses the structured states, while schedule labels are reserved for evaluation. Appendix A.2 gives the network dimensions.

paragraphs.en: We divide the twelve action bits into four groups of three, one per vehicle. This lets us test whether correlations in the prior coordinate the vehicles’ predicted futures. Each agent’s predictor receives the full observation representation and its own three random bits. Before the shared code MLP, a mask sets the other agents’ signed-bit inputs to zero. The predictor updates only that agent’s 16-dimensional representation, and the trajectory readout also decodes each agent separately. For a fixed observation, cross-agent stochastic coordination must therefore come from correlations among the prior’s bit groups.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将十二个动作比特分成四组，每组三个，每辆车一组。 这使我们能够检验先验中的相关性是否能协调各车辆的预测未来。 每个智能体的预测器接收完整的观测表征以及它自己的三个随机比特。 在共享编码 MLP 之前，一个掩码将其他智能体的带符号比特输入置为零。 预测器仅更新该智能体的 16 维表征，且轨迹读出层也会对每个智能体分别解码。 因此，对于固定的观测，跨智能体的随机协调必然来自先验各比特组之间的相关性。

sents.en: We divide the twelve action bits into four groups of three, one per vehicle.
sents.zh: 我们将十二个动作比特分成四组，每组三个，每辆车一组。

sents.en: This lets us test whether correlations in the prior coordinate the vehicles’ predicted futures.
sents.zh: 这使我们能够检验先验中的相关性是否能协调各车辆的预测未来。

sents.en: Each agent’s predictor receives the full observation representation and its own three random bits.
sents.zh: 每个智能体的预测器接收完整的观测表征以及它自己的三个随机比特。

sents.en: Before the shared code MLP, a mask sets the other agents’ signed-bit inputs to zero.
sents.zh: 在共享编码 MLP 之前，一个掩码将其他智能体的带符号比特输入置为零。

sents.en: The predictor updates only that agent’s 16-dimensional representation, and the trajectory readout also decodes each agent separately.
sents.zh: 预测器仅更新该智能体的 16 维表征，且轨迹读出层也会对每个智能体分别解码。

sents.en: For a fixed observation, cross-agent stochastic coordination must therefore come from correlations among the prior’s bit groups.
sents.zh: 因此，对于固定的观测，跨智能体的随机协调必然来自先验各比特组之间的相关性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate one energy score on the concatenated four-agent representation. paragraphs.en: We train the trajectory readout after freezing all JEPA parameters. A shared per-agent MLP maps an encoded real future to three predicted speeds, one at each future time. At inference, it receives the model’s predicted representation in place of the encoded real future. Starting from the observed position and speed, we integrate these speeds with the trapezoidal rule at three-second intervals. The MLP receives no observation features; the observed state only initializes this fixed integration step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在冻结所有 JEPA 参数后训练轨迹读出头。 一个每个智能体共享的多层感知机（MLP）将编码后的真实未来映射为三个预测速度，分别对应未来的三个时刻。 在推理时，它接收模型预测的表征来代替编码后的真实未来。 从观测到的位置和速度出发，我们以三秒为间隔，用梯形法则对这些速度进行积分。 该 MLP 不接收任何观测特征；观测状态仅用于初始化这一固定的积分步骤。

sents.zh: 我们在冻结所有 JEPA 参数后训练轨迹读出头。

sents.zh: 从观测到的位置和速度出发，我们以三秒为间隔，用梯形法则对这些速度进行积分。

sents.en: The MLP receives no observation features; the observed state only initializes this fixed integration step.
sents.zh: 该 MLP 不接收任何观测特征；观测状态仅用于初始化这一固定的积分步骤。

paragraphs.en: We fit a separate readout for each trained model using encoded real futures. Readout training never changes the encoder, predictor or prior. Appendix A.2 specifies the readout architecture, loss and optimization settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用编码后的真实未来为每个训练好的模型分别拟合一个读出头。 读出头训练从不改变编码器、预测器或先验。 附录 A.2 规定了读出头的架构、损失与优化设置。

paragraphs.en: The reference benchmark metrics use 128 prior samples per observation, including repeated codes. We decode these samples before evaluating prediction quality.
paragraphs.zh: 参考基准指标对每次观测使用 128 个先验样本，包括重复的代码。 我们在评估预测质量之前对这些样本进行解码。

sents.zh: 我们在评估预测质量之前对这些样本进行解码。

paragraphs.en: We assign each prediction to the true direction with the nearest final endpoint. The sample is valid if this endpoint error is less than 4 pixels; otherwise, we assign it to an invalid category. Coverage is the fraction of the eight directions reached by at least one valid sample. Validity is the fraction of all 128 samples that pass the endpoint test. These metrics answer different questions: coverage measures how many alternatives are recovered, whereas validity measures how reliably the prior samples plausible futures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将每个预测分配给最终端点距离最近的真实方向。 如果该端点误差小于 4 个像素，则该样本有效；否则，我们将其归为无效类别。 覆盖率是指八个方向中被至少一个有效样本到达的比例。 有效性是指在全部 128 个样本中通过端点测试的比例。 这些指标回答不同的问题：覆盖率衡量恢复了多少种备选方案，而有效性衡量先验采样出合理未来结果的可靠程度。

sents.zh: 我们将每个预测分配给最终端点距离最近的真实方向。

sents.zh: 这些指标回答不同的问题：覆盖率衡量恢复了多少种备选方案，而有效性衡量先验采样出合理未来结果的可靠程度。

paragraphs.en: A joint prediction must match one complete four-agent target future. At each of the three future times, every agent must have position error at most 2 m and speed error at most 1 m/s. For each candidate target, we divide the errors by their respective tolerances and take the largest value across agents and times. We assign the prediction to the target with the smallest resulting error. If this error exceeds one, the sample enters the invalid category. Coverage is the fraction of the 18 targets matched by at least one sample; validity is the fraction of valid joint samples. The target identities are used for evaluation only, without supplying mode labels during training.
paragraphs.zh: 联合预测必须匹配一个完整的四智能体目标未来轨迹。 在三个未来时刻中的每一个时刻，每个智能体的位置误差不得超过 2 米，速度误差不得超过 1 米/秒。 对于每个候选目标，我们将误差除以各自的容差，并取所有智能体和所有时刻中的最大值。 我们将预测分配给所得误差最小的目标。 如果该误差超过 1，则该样本进入无效类别。 覆盖率是 18 个目标中至少被一个样本匹配的比例；有效率是有效联合样本的比例。 目标身份仅用于评估，训练期间不提供模式标签。

sents.zh: 联合预测必须匹配一个完整的四智能体目标未来轨迹。

sents.zh: 对于每个候选目标，我们将误差除以各自的容差，并取所有智能体和所有时刻中的最大值。

sents.en: We assign the prediction to the target with the smallest resulting error.
sents.zh: 我们将预测分配给所得误差最小的目标。

sents.en: If this error exceeds one, the sample enters the invalid category.
sents.zh: 如果该误差超过 1，则该样本进入无效类别。

sents.zh: 覆盖率是 18 个目标中至少被一个样本匹配的比例；有效率是有效联合样本的比例。

paragraphs.en: Total variation (TV) compares the sampled category frequencies with the specified target probabilities, including the invalid category. It equals one half of the sum of absolute frequency differences across categories. MovingMNIST has eight direction categories plus one invalid category; HEP18 has 18 joint-future categories plus one invalid category. The target probability of the invalid category is zero for both tasks. MovingMNIST uses the specified cardinal and diagonal probabilities, while HEP18 assigns probability 1 / 18 1/18 to each valid future. Lower TV indicates a closer match to these probabilities, accounting for both invalid samples and incorrect frequencies among valid futures.
paragraphs.zh: 全变差（TV）将采样得到的类别频率与指定的目标概率进行比较，包括无效类别。 它等于各类别上频率绝对差之和的一半。 MovingMNIST 有八个方向类别外加一个无效类别；HEP18 有 18 个联合未来类别外加一个无效类别。 对于这两个任务，无效类别的目标概率均为零。 MovingMNIST 使用指定的基数方向与对角方向概率，而 HEP18 为每个有效的未来分配 1 / 18 1/18 的概率。 TV 越低表示与这些概率的匹配越接近，同时考虑了无效样本以及有效未来之间的错误频率。

sents.zh: 全变差（TV）将采样得到的类别频率与指定的目标概率进行比较，包括无效类别。

sents.en: It equals one half of the sum of absolute frequency differences across categories.

paragraphs.en: For minimum average displacement error (minADE), we find the sampled rollout with the smallest mean position error for each true future. Minimum final displacement error (minFDE) instead uses the position error at the last future time. Each metric selects a complete rollout, rather than combining different samples across agents or time steps. We average over target futures using their specified probabilities: the cardinal/diagonal weights for MovingMNIST and uniform weights for HEP18.
paragraphs.zh: 对于最小平均位移误差（minADE），我们为每个真实未来选择平均位置误差最小的采样轨迹。 最小最终位移误差（minFDE）则使用最后一个未来时刻的位置误差。 每个指标都会选定一条完整的轨迹，而不是在不同智能体或时间步之间混合组合不同的采样。 我们使用各目标未来指定的概率进行平均：对 MovingMNIST 使用 cardinal/diagonal 权重，对 HEP18 使用均匀权重。

sents.en: For minimum average displacement error (minADE), we find the sampled rollout with the smallest mean position error for each true future.
sents.zh: 对于最小平均位移误差（minADE），我们为每个真实未来选择平均位置误差最小的采样轨迹。

sents.en: Minimum final displacement error (minFDE) instead uses the position error at the last future time.
sents.zh: 最小最终位移误差（minFDE）则使用最后一个未来时刻的位置误差。

sents.en: Each metric selects a complete rollout, rather than combining different samples across agents or time steps.
sents.zh: 每个指标都会选定一条完整的轨迹，而不是在不同智能体或时间步之间混合组合不同的采样。

sents.en: We average over target futures using their specified probabilities: the cardinal/diagonal weights for MovingMNIST and uniform weights for HEP18.
sents.zh: 我们使用各目标未来指定的概率进行平均：对 MovingMNIST 使用 cardinal/diagonal 权重，对 HEP18 使用均匀权重。

paragraphs.en: The trajectory energy score (ES) uses Euclidean distances between flattened complete trajectories, measured in pixels for MovingMNIST and metres for HEP18. It evaluates the sampled distribution, rather than only the closest prediction to each target. For MovingMNIST, we also report the best-sample image Dice score, averaged over true futures with their specified probabilities. The Dice score measures overlap between predicted and target digit images. When evaluating the readout alone, we replace predicted features with encoded real targets. This diagnostic separates readout reconstruction quality from errors introduced by the world model.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹能量分数（ES）使用展平后的完整轨迹之间的欧氏距离，在 MovingMNIST 上以像素为单位，在 HEP18 上以米为单位进行度量。 它评估的是采样分布，而不仅仅是每个目标最接近的预测。 对于 MovingMNIST，我们还报告最佳样本图像的 Dice 分数，并按照各真实未来指定的概率进行平均。 Dice 分数衡量预测的数字图像与目标数字图像之间的重叠程度。 当单独评估读出模块时，我们用编码后的真实目标替换预测特征。 这一诊断方法将读出模块的重建质量与世界模型引入的误差区分开来。

sents.en: The trajectory energy score (ES) uses Euclidean distances between flattened complete trajectories, measured in pixels for MovingMNIST and metres for HEP18.
sents.zh: 轨迹能量分数（ES）使用展平后的完整轨迹之间的欧氏距离，在 MovingMNIST 上以像素为单位，在 HEP18 上以米为单位进行度量。

sents.en: It evaluates the sampled distribution, rather than only the closest prediction to each target.
sents.zh: 它评估的是采样分布，而不仅仅是每个目标最接近的预测。

sents.en: For MovingMNIST, we also report the best-sample image Dice score, averaged over true futures with their specified probabilities.
sents.zh: 对于 MovingMNIST，我们还报告最佳样本图像的 Dice 分数，并按照各真实未来指定的概率进行平均。

sents.en: The Dice score measures overlap between predicted and target digit images.
sents.zh: Dice 分数衡量预测的数字图像与目标数字图像之间的重叠程度。

sents.en: When evaluating the readout alone, we replace predicted features with encoded real targets.
sents.zh: 当单独评估读出模块时，我们用编码后的真实目标替换预测特征。

sents.en: This diagnostic separates readout reconstruction quality from errors introduced by the world model.
sents.zh: 这一诊断方法将读出模块的重建质量与世界模型引入的误差区分开来。

paragraphs.en: For each observation, we independently shuffle the sampled trajectories of each vehicle and recombine them into four-agent scenes. This preserves every vehicle’s set of trajectories and frequencies, while breaking their original association with other vehicles. We recompute joint validity and average the result over ten shuffles. A drop in validity shows that the original pairing contained useful cross-agent coordination. Separately, local validity checks whether each vehicle matches any of its four allowed schedules, without requiring a compatible four-agent combination. Appendix H reports checks with different sampling budgets and validity tolerances.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每次观测，我们独立打乱每辆车辆采样得到的轨迹，并将其重新组合成四智能体场景。 这样做保留了每辆车的轨迹集合及其频率，同时破坏了它们与其他车辆之间的原始关联。 我们重新计算联合有效性，并在十次打乱上取平均结果。 有效性的下降表明原始配对中包含有用的跨智能体协调。 另外，局部有效性检验每辆车是否匹配其四个允许时刻表中的任意一个，而不要求存在兼容的四智能体组合。 附录 H 报告了不同采样预算和有效性容差下的检验结果。

sents.en: For each observation, we independently shuffle the sampled trajectories of each vehicle and recombine them into four-agent scenes.
sents.zh: 对于每次观测，我们独立打乱每辆车辆采样得到的轨迹，并将其重新组合成四智能体场景。

sents.en: This preserves every vehicle’s set of trajectories and frequencies, while breaking their original association with other vehicles.
sents.zh: 这样做保留了每辆车的轨迹集合及其频率，同时破坏了它们与其他车辆之间的原始关联。

sents.en: We recompute joint validity and average the result over ten shuffles.
sents.zh: 我们重新计算联合有效性，并在十次打乱上取平均结果。

sents.en: A drop in validity shows that the original pairing contained useful cross-agent coordination.
sents.zh: 有效性的下降表明原始配对中包含有用的跨智能体协调。

sents.en: Separately, local validity checks whether each vehicle matches any of its four allowed schedules, without requiring a compatible four-agent combination.
sents.zh: 另外，局部有效性检验每辆车是否匹配其四个允许时刻表中的任意一个，而不要求存在兼容的四智能体组合。

sents.en: Appendix H reports checks with different sampling budgets and validity tolerances.
sents.zh: 附录 H 报告了不同采样预算和有效性容差下的检验结果。

paragraphs.en: We test whether regularizing t − h t-h improves training stability on HEP18. The alternative removes only R ⁡ ( t − h ) R(t-h) , retaining the joint predictive energy and the same coefficients on R ⁡ ( h ) R(h) and R ⁡ ( t ) R(t) . We train each configuration from three matched initializations and evaluate it on the 64-observation validation split. Quantum models use ideal circuit gradients in this ablation, so finite-shot noise does not confound the objective comparison ( Table 11 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试对 t − h 进行正则化是否能提升 HEP18 上的训练稳定性。 该替代方案仅移除 R(t-h)，保留联合预测能量以及在 R(h) 和 R(t) 上相同的系数。 我们使用三个匹配的初始化分别训练每种配置，并在包含 64 个观测的验证集上进行评估。 在此消融实验中，量子模型使用理想电路梯度，因此有限采样噪声不会干扰客观比较（表 11）。

sents.en: We test whether regularizing t − h t-h improves training stability on HEP18.
sents.zh: 我们测试对 t − h 进行正则化是否能提升 HEP18 上的训练稳定性。

sents.en: The alternative removes only R ⁡ ( t − h ) R(t-h) , retaining the joint predictive energy and the same coefficients on R ⁡ ( h ) R(h) and R ⁡ ( t ) R(t) .
sents.zh: 该替代方案仅移除 R(t-h)，保留联合预测能量以及在 R(h) 和 R(t) 上相同的系数。

sents.en: We train each configuration from three matched initializations and evaluate it on the 64-observation validation split.
sents.zh: 我们使用三个匹配的初始化分别训练每种配置，并在包含 64 个观测的验证集上进行评估。

sents.en: Quantum models use ideal circuit gradients in this ablation, so finite-shot noise does not confound the objective comparison ( Table 11 ).
sents.zh: 在此消融实验中，量子模型使用理想电路梯度，因此有限采样噪声不会干扰客观比较（表 11）。

paragraphs.en: Removing change regularization produced much greater variation across training runs for Entangled-QCBM. Two runs retained high coverage and validity, but the third generated mostly invalid continuations. For that run, decoding encoded real targets still gave 100% validity. The readout could therefore reconstruct valid motion from target features; the failure arose when using the model’s predicted features. Mixture-4 also lost accuracy in its third run, although less severely.
paragraphs.zh: 移除变更正则化后，Entangled-QCBM 在不同训练运行之间的差异明显增大。 两次运行保持了较高的覆盖率和有效率，但第三次运行生成的延续大多无效。 对于该次运行，解码编码后的真实目标仍然达到了 100% 的有效率。 因此，读出层能够从目标特征中重建出有效的动作；失败出现在使用模型预测特征的情况下。 Mixture-4 在其第三次运行中也损失了准确性，尽管程度较轻。

sents.en: Removing change regularization produced much greater variation across training runs for Entangled-QCBM.
sents.zh: 移除变更正则化后，Entangled-QCBM 在不同训练运行之间的差异明显增大。

sents.en: Two runs retained high coverage and validity, but the third generated mostly invalid continuations.
sents.zh: 两次运行保持了较高的覆盖率和有效率，但第三次运行生成的延续大多无效。

sents.en: For that run, decoding encoded real targets still gave 100% validity.
sents.zh: 对于该次运行，解码编码后的真实目标仍然达到了 100% 的有效率。

sents.en: The readout could therefore reconstruct valid motion from target features; the failure arose when using the model’s predicted features.
sents.zh: 因此，读出层能够从目标特征中重建出有效的动作；失败出现在使用模型预测特征的情况下。

sents.en: Mixture-4 also lost accuracy in its third run, although less severely.
sents.zh: Mixture-4 在其第三次运行中也损失了准确性，尽管程度较轻。

paragraphs.en: With change regularization, all three Entangled-QCBM runs retained high coverage and validity. This ablation supports retaining R ⁡ ( t − h ) R(t-h) to stabilize the present HEP18 training setup. It evaluates ideal-gradient training; the separate finite-shot comparison is reported in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 采用变化正则化后，三次 Entangled-QCBM 运行都保持了较高的覆盖率和有效性。 该消融实验支持保留 R ⁡ ( t − h ) R(t-h) 以稳定当前的 HEP18 训练设置。 它评估的是理想梯度训练；单独的有限样本比较见附录 D。

sents.en: With change regularization, all three Entangled-QCBM runs retained high coverage and validity.
sents.zh: 采用变化正则化后，三次 Entangled-QCBM 运行都保持了较高的覆盖率和有效性。

sents.en: It evaluates ideal-gradient training; the separate finite-shot comparison is reported in Appendix D .
sents.zh: 它评估的是理想梯度训练；单独的有限样本比较见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: The sampling-budget checks and direction-frequency figure use ideal-gradient reference checkpoints, as indicated in their captions.
paragraphs.zh: 采样预算检查与方向频率图使用理想梯度参考检查点，如其图注中所述。

paragraphs.en: For HEP18, each sampled four-agent trajectory is assigned to its nearest target using the normalized-error rule in Appendix F.4 . If the sample exceeds the tolerance, it enters the invalid category. A model can therefore have high coverage but low validity: it may occasionally reach every target while producing many invalid samples. Conversely, a model that repeatedly predicts one valid future can have high validity but low coverage. TV also measures whether the frequencies of valid futures are correct. The metrics capture different properties and need not rank methods identically. A deterministic model repeats the same continuation within each observation, so shuffling its draws leaves all metrics unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 HEP18，每条采样得到的四智能体轨迹都会使用附录 F.4 中的归一化误差规则被分配到其最近的目标。 如果样本超出容差，则进入无效类别。 因此，一个模型可能具有高覆盖率但低有效性：它可能偶尔能到达每个目标，同时产生许多无效样本。 相反，一个反复预测同一个有效未来的模型可能具有高有效性但低覆盖率。 TV 还衡量有效未来的频率是否正确。 这些指标捕捉不同的属性，不必以相同的方式对方法进行排名。 确定性模型在每次观测内重复相同的后续动作，因此对其采样结果进行打乱不会改变任何指标。

sents.zh: TV 还衡量有效未来的频率是否正确。

paragraphs.en: We reevaluate the first 32 and first 64 draws from each existing 128-draw sample set. Using these nested subsets changes the sampling budget without drawing a new set of predictions. We also test position/speed tolerances of 1 m/0.5 m/s and 3 m/1.5 m/s, keeping all 128 draws. The main evaluation retains its fixed tolerances of 2 m and 1 m/s. These checks show how the reported metrics respond to stricter matching or fewer samples.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每个已有的 128 次采样集合重新评估前 32 次和前 64 次采样。 使用这些嵌套子集可以在不重新绘制一组预测的情况下改变采样预算。 我们还测试了 1 m/0.5 m/s 和 3 m/1.5 m/s 的位置/速度容差，并保留全部 128 次采样。 主评估保留其固定的 2 m 和 1 m/s 容差。 这些检查展示了所报告的指标在更严格的匹配或更少的样本下的变化情况。

sents.en: We reevaluate the first 32 and first 64 draws from each existing 128-draw sample set.
sents.zh: 我们对每个已有的 128 次采样集合重新评估前 32 次和前 64 次采样。

sents.en: Using these nested subsets changes the sampling budget without drawing a new set of predictions.
sents.zh: 使用这些嵌套子集可以在不重新绘制一组预测的情况下改变采样预算。

paragraphs.en: For a finite-sample reference, we draw 128 futures directly from the true uniform distribution over the 18 targets. Its empirical TV is generally nonzero because sampled frequencies fluctuate, even when the underlying distribution is correct.
paragraphs.zh: 作为有限样本的参照，我们直接从18个目标的真实均匀分布中抽取128个未来结果。 即使底层的分布是正确的，由于采样频率存在波动，其经验总变差（TV）通常也不是零。

sents.en: For a finite-sample reference, we draw 128 futures directly from the true uniform distribution over the 18 targets.
sents.zh: 作为有限样本的参照，我们直接从18个目标的真实均匀分布中抽取128个未来结果。

sents.zh: 即使底层的分布是正确的，由于采样频率存在波动，其经验总变差（TV）通常也不是零。

paragraphs.en: The ± \pm values in the training-result tables are sample standard deviations across independently trained models. They do not describe variation among the 128 draws from one model. Equal rounded entries can occur when different sample sets contain the same codes needed to achieve the best predictions. Further repetitions change code frequencies, but not coverage or best-sample errors once those codes have been drawn. Equal displayed values therefore do not imply identical sampled distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 训练结果表中的 ± \pm 值是跨多个独立训练模型得到的样本标准差。 它们并不描述同一模型的 128 次抽取之间的变化。 当不同的样本集包含实现最佳预测所需的相同代码时，可能出现舍入后相等的数值。 进一步的重复会改变代码的频率，但一旦这些代码已被抽取，就不会改变覆盖率或最佳样本误差。 因此，显示值相等并不意味着抽样分布完全相同。

paragraphs.en: We first train on data in which different digits have different future-direction probabilities. We then test whether the trained prior uses the observation by changing only its input features during evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先在“不同数字具有不同未来方向概率”的数据上进行训练。 然后我们通过在评估时仅改变该观测的输入特征，来测试训练得到的先验是否利用了这一观测。

sents.zh: 然后我们通过在评估时仅改变该观测的输入特征，来测试训练得到的先验是否利用了这一观测。

sents.en: We use handwritten zeros and ones.
sents.zh: 我们使用手写的数字 0 和 1。

paragraphs.en: The direction distribution is non-uniform for digit 0 and uniform for digit 1. Per digit, we use 400 training and 40 disjoint development sprites from MNIST’s training split, and 40 sprites from its official test split. Vertical positions are paired across digit classes. The clips and motion steps follow Appendix F.2 . Each training example supplies observation images and one sampled future. Digit labels only set the sampling probabilities; the model is trained from images.
paragraphs.zh: 对于数字 0，方向分布是非均匀的；对于数字 1，方向分布是均匀的。 对每个数字，我们从 MNIST 的训练集中使用 400 个训练精灵图和 40 个不相交的开发精灵图，并从其官方测试集中使用 40 个精灵图。 垂直位置在各数字类别之间是配对的。 视频片段和运动步数遵循附录 F.2。 每个训练样本提供观测图像和一个采样的未来。 数字标签只用于设定采样概率；模型是从图像训练得到的。

sents.zh: 对于数字 0，方向分布是非均匀的；对于数字 1，方向分布是均匀的。

paragraphs.en: Both QCBMs use the three-bit MovingMNIST architectures, energy score, two-view VISReg, optimizers and warm-up schedule in Appendix A . We train three models per circuit family, each with 4,000 JEPA updates followed by 4,000 readout updates with the JEPA weights frozen. We use the parameter-shift budgets in Table 5 , with 0.5% independent readout flips during training and evaluation. The recorded budget is 145,536,000 simulated training shots per run. We retain all six final checkpoints without using the reserved development bank for tuning or checkpoint selection. The “Original observation” rows in Table 13 report normal prediction on this new dataset, averaged across both digits.
paragraphs.zh: 两种 QCBM 均使用附录 A 中的三比特 MovingMNIST 架构、能量评分、双视角 VISReg、优化器与预热调度。 我们对每个线路族训练三个模型，每个模型先进行 4,000 次 JEPA 更新，随后在冻结 JEPA 权重的情况下进行 4,000 次 readout 更新。 我们使用表 5 中的参数移位预算，训练与评估期间 readout 以 0.5% 的概率独立翻转。 记录的预算为每次运行 145,536,000 个模拟训练 shot。 我们保留全部六个最终检查点，不使用保留的开发库进行调参或检查点选择。 表 13 中的「Original observation」行报告了在该新数据集上的正常预测结果，并在两个数字上取平均。

sents.en: We use the parameter-shift budgets in Table 5 , with 0.5% independent readout flips during training and evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们使用表 5 中的参数移位预算，训练与评估期间 readout 以 0.5% 的概率独立翻转。

sents.en: The recorded budget is 145,536,000 simulated training shots per run.
sents.zh: 记录的预算为每次运行 145,536,000 个模拟训练 shot。

sents.en: We retain all six final checkpoints without using the reserved development bank for tuning or checkpoint selection.
sents.zh: 我们保留全部六个最终检查点，不使用保留的开发库进行调参或检查点选择。

sents.en: The “Original observation” rows in Table 13 report normal prediction on this new dataset, averaged across both digits.
sents.zh: 表 13 中的「Original observation」行报告了在该新数据集上的正常预测结果，并在两个数字上取平均。

paragraphs.en: Both the prior and predictor receive the observation, so either can make the predicted direction distribution depend on the digit. To isolate the prior’s contribution, we fix all weights and keep the original observation representation h h at the predictor and readout. sents.en: To isolate the prior’s contribution, we fix all weights and keep the original observation representation h h at the predictor and readout.
sents.zh: 为了分离先验的贡献，我们固定所有权重，并在预测器和读出层保留原始观测表示 h h。

sents.en: We replace only the prior input with h ~ \widetilde{h} : Z ∼ p θ ( ⋅ ∣ h ~ ) Z\sim p_{\theta}(\cdot\mid\widetilde{h}) and t ^ = P ψ ​ ( h , Z ) \widehat{t}=P_{\psi}(h,Z) .
sents.zh: 我们只将先验的输入替换为 h ~ \widetilde{h}：Z ∼ p θ ( ⋅ ∣ h ~ ) Z\sim p_{\theta}(\cdot\mid\widetilde{h})，且 t ^ = P ψ ​ ( h , Z ) \widehat{t}=P_{\psi}(h,Z)。

sents.en: Normal inference uses h ~ = h \widetilde{h}=h .
sents.zh: 正常推断使用 h ~ = h \widetilde{h}=h。

paragraphs.en: We compare the original input with three replacements. These are the next image of the same digit, the other digit at the same vertical position, and a randomly selected training observation. For the last condition, we draw a new training observation for every prior sample. For example, a zero still enters the predictor while the prior receives features of a one; predictions are still scored against q 0 q_{0} . All conditions are scored against the original digit’s target probabilities. The random training inputs remove the link between the prior input and the current observation. The same-digit replacement can also change vertical position. For each of 80 test observations, we pool three groups of 128 predictions, compute TV including invalid samples, and average over observations. We report standard deviations across the three independent training runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将原始输入与三种替换进行比较。 它们分别是同一数字的下一张图像、处于相同垂直位置的另一个数字，以及随机选取的一个训练观测。 对于最后一种条件，我们为每个先前样本抽取一个新的训练观测。 例如，一个零仍然进入预测器，而先验接收到的是数字一的特征；预测仍然针对 q 0 q_{0} 进行评分。 所有条件都针对原始数字的目标概率进行评分。 随机训练输入消除了先验输入与当前观测之间的关联。 同一数字的替换也可能改变垂直位置。 对于 80 个测试观测中的每一个，我们汇集三组各 128 个预测，计算包含无效样本的 TV，并在各观测之间取平均。 我们报告三次独立训练运行之间的标准差。

sents.en: We compare the original input with three replacements.
sents.zh: 我们将原始输入与三种替换进行比较。

sents.en: These are the next image of the same digit, the other digit at the same vertical position, and a randomly selected training observation.
sents.zh: 它们分别是同一数字的下一张图像、处于相同垂直位置的另一个数字，以及随机选取的一个训练观测。

sents.en: For the last condition, we draw a new training observation for every prior sample.
sents.zh: 对于最后一种条件，我们为每个先前样本抽取一个新的训练观测。

sents.en: For example, a zero still enters the predictor while the prior receives features of a one; predictions are still scored against q 0 q_{0} .
sents.zh: 例如，一个零仍然进入预测器，而先验接收到的是数字一的特征；预测仍然针对 q 0 q_{0} 进行评分。

sents.en: All conditions are scored against the original digit’s target probabilities.
sents.zh: 所有条件都针对原始数字的目标概率进行评分。

sents.en: The random training inputs remove the link between the prior input and the current observation.
sents.zh: 随机训练输入消除了先验输入与当前观测之间的关联。

sents.en: The same-digit replacement can also change vertical position.
sents.zh: 同一数字的替换也可能改变垂直位置。

sents.en: For each of 80 test observations, we pool three groups of 128 predictions, compute TV including invalid samples, and average over observations.
sents.zh: 对于 80 个测试观测中的每一个，我们汇集三组各 128 个预测，计算包含无效样本的 TV，并在各观测之间取平均。

sents.en: We report standard deviations across the three independent training runs.
sents.zh: 我们报告三次独立训练运行之间的标准差。

paragraphs.en: Replacing the prior input with the other digit increases prediction TV in all three runs of both circuit families. The paired mean increase is 0.020 ± 0.014 0.020\pm 0.014 for Product-QCBM and 0.065 ± 0.023 0.065\pm 0.023 for Entangled-QCBM. For Entangled-QCBM, the training-input mixture worsens TV in all three runs; the Product-QCBM effect is smaller and reverses slightly in one run. Thus the prior contributes useful observation-dependent probabilities, with a stronger effect for Entangled-QCBM in this check.
paragraphs.zh: 用另一个数字替换先验输入后，两个电路族的所有三次运行中预测 TV 均增加。 配对平均增幅为：Product-QCBM 为 0.020 ± 0.014 0.020\pm 0.014，Entangled-QCBM 为 0.065 ± 0.023 0.065\pm 0.023。 对于 Entangled-QCBM，训练输入混合在所有三次运行中都使 TV 变差；Product-QCBM 的影响较小，且在其中一次运行中略有反转。 因此，先验提供了有用的、依赖于观测的概率，在此检查中它对 Entangled-QCBM 的影响更强。

sents.en: Replacing the prior input with the other digit increases prediction TV in all three runs of both circuit families.
sents.zh: 用另一个数字替换先验输入后，两个电路族的所有三次运行中预测 TV 均增加。

sents.en: The paired mean increase is 0.020 ± 0.014 0.020\pm 0.014 for Product-QCBM and 0.065 ± 0.023 0.065\pm 0.023 for Entangled-QCBM.
sents.zh: 配对平均增幅为：Product-QCBM 为 0.020 ± 0.014 0.020\pm 0.014，Entangled-QCBM 为 0.065 ± 0.023 0.065\pm 0.023。

sents.en: For Entangled-QCBM, the training-input mixture worsens TV in all three runs; the Product-QCBM effect is smaller and reverses slightly in one run.
sents.zh: 对于 Entangled-QCBM，训练输入混合在所有三次运行中都使 TV 变差；Product-QCBM 的影响较小，且在其中一次运行中略有反转。

sents.en: Thus the prior contributes useful observation-dependent probabilities, with a stronger effect for Entangled-QCBM in this check.
sents.zh: 因此，先验提供了有用的、依赖于观测的概率，在此检查中它对 Entangled-QCBM 的影响更强。

paragraphs.en: After averaging sampled code frequencies within each digit class, the TV between the two classes is 0.041 ± 0.018 0.041\pm 0.018 for Product-QCBM and 0.074 ± 0.028 0.074\pm 0.028 for Entangled-QCBM. Every input condition samples all eight codes, and each code’s predicted future stays fixed because the predictor input is unchanged. Coverage therefore stays the same, while the direction frequencies change. These differences are computed within each trained model, because bit codes need not have the same meaning across initializations. Decoding encoded real targets gives mean endpoint errors of 0.66 pixels for both families, below the four-pixel matching threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个数字类别内对采样的码频取平均后，两类之间的总变差（TV）对于 Product-QCBM 为 0.041 ± 0.018 0.041\pm 0.018，对于 Entangled-QCBM 为 0.074 ± 0.028 0.074\pm 0.028。 每个输入条件都会采样到全部八种码，且由于预测器的输入保持不变，每种码预测的未来也保持固定。 因此覆盖度保持不变，而各方向的频率发生变化。 这些差异是在每个已训练模型内部计算的，因为比特码在不同初始化之间未必要有相同的含义。 对编码后的真实目标进行解码，两个模型家族的平均端点误差均为 0.66 像素，低于四像素的匹配阈值。

sents.en: After averaging sampled code frequencies within each digit class, the TV between the two classes is 0.041 ± 0.018 0.041\pm 0.018 for Product-QCBM and 0.074 ± 0.028 0.074\pm 0.028 for Entangled-QCBM.
sents.zh: 在每个数字类别内对采样的码频取平均后，两类之间的总变差（TV）对于 Product-QCBM 为 0.041 ± 0.018 0.041\pm 0.018，对于 Entangled-QCBM 为 0.074 ± 0.028 0.074\pm 0.028。

sents.en: Every input condition samples all eight codes, and each code’s predicted future stays fixed because the predictor input is unchanged.
sents.zh: 每个输入条件都会采样到全部八种码，且由于预测器的输入保持不变，每种码预测的未来也保持固定。

sents.en: Coverage therefore stays the same, while the direction frequencies change.
sents.zh: 因此覆盖度保持不变，而各方向的频率发生变化。

sents.en: These differences are computed within each trained model, because bit codes need not have the same meaning across initializations.
sents.zh: 这些差异是在每个已训练模型内部计算的，因为比特码在不同初始化之间未必要有相同的含义。

sents.en: Decoding encoded real targets gives mean endpoint errors of 0.66 pixels for both families, below the four-pixel matching threshold.
sents.zh: 对编码后的真实目标进行解码，两个模型家族的平均端点误差均为 0.66 像素，低于四像素的匹配阈值。

paragraphs.en: These results show that the prior uses observation features to adjust future probabilities. Replacements within the same digit class also affect TV, indicating sensitivity to more than digit identity.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，该先验利用观测特征来调整未来概率。 同一数字类别内的替换也会影响 TV，表明其敏感度不仅限于数字身份。

sents.en: These results show that the prior uses observation features to adjust future probabilities.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，该先验利用观测特征来调整未来概率。

sents.en: Replacements within the same digit class also affect TV, indicating sensitivity to more than digit identity.
sents.zh: 同一数字类别内的替换也会影响 TV，表明其敏感度不仅限于数字身份。

paragraphs.en: We used the LQCloud cloud service to access the MQ02 and AGate-100 quantum processors for MovingMNIST and HEP18, respectively. The QPU generated latent-action bit strings, while the encoder, conditioner, predictor and readout ran classically. Each measurement shot denotes one circuit execution and returns one bit string.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 LQCloud 云服务分别访问 MQ02 和 AGate-100 量子处理器，以处理 MovingMNIST 和 HEP18。 QPU 生成潜在动作比特串，而编码器、条件器、预测器和读出部分则以经典方式运行。 每次测量 shot 表示一次电路执行，并返回一个比特串。

sents.en: We used the LQCloud cloud service to access the MQ02 and AGate-100 quantum processors for MovingMNIST and HEP18, respectively.
sents.zh: 我们使用 LQCloud 云服务分别访问 MQ02 和 AGate-100 量子处理器，以处理 MovingMNIST 和 HEP18。

sents.en: The QPU generated latent-action bit strings, while the encoder, conditioner, predictor and readout ran classically.
sents.zh: QPU 生成潜在动作比特串，而编码器、条件器、预测器和读出部分则以经典方式运行。

sents.en: Each measurement shot denotes one circuit execution and returns one bit string.
sents.zh: 每次测量 shot 表示一次电路执行，并返回一个比特串。

paragraphs.en: We deployed trained three-qubit Product-QCBM and Entangled-QCBM priors on the MQ02 quantum processor. Both use unchanged ideal-gradient reference weights, rather than the noisy parameter-shift checkpoints in the main tables. For each of the first eight MovingMNIST test observations, the encoder and conditioner produce the circuit’s nine rotation angles. The Entangled-QCBM circuit contains two CNOT gates, while Product-QCBM omits them. Both circuit families include their trained terminal rotations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MQ02 量子处理器上部署了训练好的三量子比特 Product-QCBM 与 Entangled-QCBM 先验。 两者均使用未改动的理想梯度参考权重，而非主表中带噪声的参数移位检查点。 对于前八个 MovingMNIST 测试观测中的每一个，编码器与条件器都会生成该线路的九个旋转角。 Entangled-QCBM 线路包含两个 CNOT 门，而 Product-QCBM 则省去了它们。 两类线路均包含其训练得到的末端旋转。

sents.en: We deployed trained three-qubit Product-QCBM and Entangled-QCBM priors on the MQ02 quantum processor.
sents.zh: 我们在 MQ02 量子处理器上部署了训练好的三量子比特 Product-QCBM 与 Entangled-QCBM 先验。

sents.en: Both use unchanged ideal-gradient reference weights, rather than the noisy parameter-shift checkpoints in the main tables.
sents.zh: 两者均使用未改动的理想梯度参考权重，而非主表中带噪声的参数移位检查点。

sents.en: For each of the first eight MovingMNIST test observations, the encoder and conditioner produce the circuit’s nine rotation angles.
sents.zh: 对于前八个 MovingMNIST 测试观测中的每一个，编码器与条件器都会生成该线路的九个旋转角。

sents.en: The Entangled-QCBM circuit contains two CNOT gates, while Product-QCBM omits them.
sents.zh: Entangled-QCBM 线路包含两个 CNOT 门，而 Product-QCBM 则省去了它们。

sents.en: Both circuit families include their trained terminal rotations.
sents.zh: 两类线路均包含其训练得到的末端旋转。

paragraphs.en: Before submission, we checked that each exported circuit reproduced the simulator’s ideal probabilities. We then used three basis-state preparations to verify the ordering of bits returned by the device. For each circuit, we collected 1,024 measurement shots without readout correction. Each measured code was passed directly through the frozen predictor and image readout.
paragraphs.zh: 在提交之前，我们检查了每个导出的电路都能复现模拟器的理想概率。 随后，我们使用三种基态制备来验证设备返回的比特顺序。 对于每个电路，我们收集了 1,024 次测量采样，且未进行读出校正。 每个测量到的编码都直接通过冻结的预测器和图像读出进行处理。

sents.en: Before submission, we checked that each exported circuit reproduced the simulator’s ideal probabilities.
sents.zh: 在提交之前，我们检查了每个导出的电路都能复现模拟器的理想概率。

sents.en: We then used three basis-state preparations to verify the ordering of bits returned by the device.
sents.zh: 随后，我们使用三种基态制备来验证设备返回的比特顺序。

sents.en: For each circuit, we collected 1,024 measurement shots without readout correction.
sents.zh: 对于每个电路，我们收集了 1,024 次测量采样，且未进行读出校正。

sents.en: Each measured code was passed directly through the frozen predictor and image readout.
sents.zh: 每个测量到的编码都直接通过冻结的预测器和图像读出进行处理。

paragraphs.en: The primary comparison uses the first 128 shots per observation, matching the main evaluation’s sample budget. We divide the remaining shots into seven further groups of 128. These groups measure repeated sampling of the same trained circuit, not variation across independent training runs.
paragraphs.zh: 主要对比使用每次观测的前 128 个 shot，与主评估的样本预算保持一致。 我们将剩余的 shot 划分为七组，每组 128 个。 这些组衡量的是对同一训练后电路的重复采样，而非多次独立训练运行之间的差异。

sents.en: The primary comparison uses the first 128 shots per observation, matching the main evaluation’s sample budget.
sents.zh: 主要对比使用每次观测的前 128 个 shot，与主评估的样本预算保持一致。

sents.en: We divide the remaining shots into seven further groups of 128.
sents.zh: 我们将剩余的 shot 划分为七组，每组 128 个。

sents.en: These groups measure repeated sampling of the same trained circuit, not variation across independent training runs.
sents.zh: 这些组衡量的是对同一训练后电路的重复采样，而非多次独立训练运行之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: Table 14 shows that hardware-generated actions can drive the complete prediction pipeline with similar results to ideal sampling. Within each circuit family, coverage and minimum ADE were identical for the two sampling sources. Both sources recovered all eight codes for these observations, so they supplied the same set of possible decoded predictions. Their code frequencies differed, which changed TV and energy score. This three-qubit experiment evaluates hardware deployment; the larger-register resource analysis is given in Section 4.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 表14表明，硬件生成的动作可以驱动完整的预测流水线，其结果与理想采样相近。 在每个电路系列中，两种采样来源的覆盖率和最小ADE完全相同。 两种来源都为这些观测恢复了全部八种编码，因此它们提供了同一组可能的解码预测。 它们的编码频率不同，这改变了TV和能量得分。 这个三量子比特实验评估的是硬件部署；更大寄存器的资源分析见第4.2节。

sents.en: Table 14 shows that hardware-generated actions can drive the complete prediction pipeline with similar results to ideal sampling.
sents.zh: 表14表明，硬件生成的动作可以驱动完整的预测流水线，其结果与理想采样相近。

sents.en: Within each circuit family, coverage and minimum ADE were identical for the two sampling sources.
sents.zh: 在每个电路系列中，两种采样来源的覆盖率和最小ADE完全相同。

sents.en: Both sources recovered all eight codes for these observations, so they supplied the same set of possible decoded predictions.
sents.zh: 两种来源都为这些观测恢复了全部八种编码，因此它们提供了同一组可能的解码预测。

sents.en: Their code frequencies differed, which changed TV and energy score.
sents.zh: 它们的编码频率不同，这改变了TV和能量得分。

sents.en: This three-qubit experiment evaluates hardware deployment; the larger-register resource analysis is given in Section 4.2 .
sents.zh: 这个三量子比特实验评估的是硬件部署；更大寄存器的资源分析见第4.2节。

paragraphs.en: A hardware layout assigns the circuit’s qubits to physical qubits and connections on the processor. Gate and measurement errors vary across the device, so layouts implementing the same ideal circuit can produce different sampled code frequencies.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件布局将该电路的量子比特分配到处理器上的物理量子比特及其连接。 门误差和测量误差在整个器件上各不相同，因此实现同一理想电路的布局可能产生不同的采样码频。

sents.en: A hardware layout assigns the circuit’s qubits to physical qubits and connections on the processor.
sents.zh: 硬件布局将该电路的量子比特分配到处理器上的物理量子比特及其连接。

sents.en: Gate and measurement errors vary across the device, so layouts implementing the same ideal circuit can produce different sampled code frequencies.
sents.zh: 门误差和测量误差在整个器件上各不相同，因此实现同一理想电路的布局可能产生不同的采样码频。

paragraphs.en: We used one fixed 12-qubit Entangled-QCBM checkpoint trained with the noisy parameter-shift configuration in Table 3 . The encoder, conditioner, predictor, readout and every circuit parameter remained unchanged throughout deployment. The four-layer circuit contains 60 single-qubit rotations, including the terminal rotations, and 20 logical CNOT gates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了一个在表 3 的含噪参数移位配置下训练的固定的 12 比特 Entangled-QCBM 检查点。 编码器、调节器、预测器、读出层以及所有电路参数在整个部署过程中保持不变。 该四层电路包含 60 个单比特旋转门（包括末端旋转门）和 20 个逻辑 CNOT 门。

sents.en: We used one fixed 12-qubit Entangled-QCBM checkpoint trained with the noisy parameter-shift configuration in Table 3 .
sents.zh: 我们使用了一个在表 3 的含噪参数移位配置下训练的固定的 12 比特 Entangled-QCBM 检查点。

sents.en: The encoder, conditioner, predictor, readout and every circuit parameter remained unchanged throughout deployment.
sents.zh: 编码器、调节器、预测器、读出层以及所有电路参数在整个部署过程中保持不变。

sents.en: The four-layer circuit contains 60 single-qubit rotations, including the terminal rotations, and 20 logical CNOT gates.
sents.zh: 该四层电路包含 60 个单比特旋转门（包括末端旋转门）和 20 个逻辑 CNOT 门。

paragraphs.en: On the AGate-100 quantum processor, we mapped the twelve circuit qubits to a 4 × 3 4\times 3 physical grid. Three SWAP gates moved quantum states between connected qubits to implement the required interactions. The compiled circuit used 29 two-qubit controlled-Z (CZ) gates and 67 single-qubit instructions. After measurement, we restored the logical bit order before passing codes to the predictor. Numerical checks found absolute differences below 10 − 16 10^{-16} between the ideal output probabilities before and after compilation.
paragraphs.zh: 在 AGate-100 量子处理器上，我们将十二个电路量子比特映射到一个 4 × 3 4\times 3 的物理网格上。 三个 SWAP 门在相连的量子比特之间移动量子态，以实现所需的相互作用。 编译后的电路使用了 29 个双量子比特 controlled-Z（CZ）门和 67 条单量子比特指令。 测量之后，我们在将编码传递给预测器之前恢复了逻辑比特顺序。 数值检查发现，编译前后的理想输出概率之间的绝对差异低于 10 − 16 10^{-16}。

sents.en: On the AGate-100 quantum processor, we mapped the twelve circuit qubits to a 4 × 3 4\times 3 physical grid.
sents.zh: 在 AGate-100 量子处理器上，我们将十二个电路量子比特映射到一个 4 × 3 4\times 3 的物理网格上。

sents.en: Three SWAP gates moved quantum states between connected qubits to implement the required interactions.
sents.zh: 三个 SWAP 门在相连的量子比特之间移动量子态，以实现所需的相互作用。

sents.en: The compiled circuit used 29 two-qubit controlled-Z (CZ) gates and 67 single-qubit instructions.
sents.zh: 编译后的电路使用了 29 个双量子比特 controlled-Z（CZ）门和 67 条单量子比特指令。

sents.en: After measurement, we restored the logical bit order before passing codes to the predictor.
sents.zh: 测量之后，我们在将编码传递给预测器之前恢复了逻辑比特顺序。

sents.en: Numerical checks found absolute differences below 10 − 16 10^{-16} between the ideal output probabilities before and after compilation.
sents.zh: 数值检查发现，编译前后的理想输出概率之间的绝对差异低于 10 − 16 10^{-16}。

paragraphs.en: We screened six physical layouts using device calibration information and simulated sensitivity to individual injected gate errors. We selected the layout with the lowest joint TV on four development observations, then confirmed its improvement on 16 additional observations. Next, we tested four reflected orientations of the grid using the same four development observations. We fixed the best orientation before evaluating the final observations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用设备校准信息筛选了六种物理布局，并模拟其对各个注入的门错误的敏感度。 我们在四个开发观测上选择联合TV最低的布局，随后在16个额外观测上确认了其改进效果。 接下来，我们在相同的四个开发观测上测试了栅格的四种反射朝向。 在评估最终观测之前，我们固定了最佳朝向。

sents.en: We screened six physical layouts using device calibration information and simulated sensitivity to individual injected gate errors.
sents.zh: 我们利用设备校准信息筛选了六种物理布局，并模拟其对各个注入的门错误的敏感度。

sents.en: We selected the layout with the lowest joint TV on four development observations, then confirmed its improvement on 16 additional observations.
sents.zh: 我们在四个开发观测上选择联合TV最低的布局，随后在16个额外观测上确认了其改进效果。

sents.en: Next, we tested four reflected orientations of the grid using the same four development observations.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们在相同的四个开发观测上测试了栅格的四种反射朝向。

sents.en: We fixed the best orientation before evaluating the final observations.
sents.zh: 在评估最终观测之前，我们固定了最佳朝向。

paragraphs.en: These layout changes leave circuit angles, gate counts and the ideal Born distribution unchanged. The final assignment of virtual wires (the numbered qubits in the exported circuit) to physical qubits was ( 67 , 66 , 3 , 68 , 65 , 36 , 69 , 64 , 37 , 70 , 63 , 38 ) (67,66,3,68,65,36,69,64,37,70,63,38) . The logical-to-wire permutation was ( 0 , 1 , 2 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 3 , 4 , 5 ) (0,1,2,6,7,8,9,10,11,3,4,5) . Its entries specify the virtual wire used by each logical qubit; both lists use zero-based indices.
paragraphs.zh: 这些布局更改不会改变电路角度、门数量和理想的 Born 分布。 虚拟导线（导出电路中编号的量子比特）到物理量子比特的最终分配为 ( 67 , 66 , 3 , 68 , 65 , 36 , 69 , 64 , 37 , 70 , 63 , 38 ) (67,66,3,68,65,36,69,64,37,70,63,38) 。 逻辑量子比特到导线的置换为 ( 0 , 1 , 2 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 3 , 4 , 5 ) (0,1,2,6,7,8,9,10,11,3,4,5) 。 其条目指定了每个逻辑量子比特所使用的虚拟导线；两个列表均使用从零开始的索引。

sents.en: These layout changes leave circuit angles, gate counts and the ideal Born distribution unchanged.
sents.zh: 这些布局更改不会改变电路角度、门数量和理想的 Born 分布。

sents.en: The final assignment of virtual wires (the numbered qubits in the exported circuit) to physical qubits was ( 67 , 66 , 3 , 68 , 65 , 36 , 69 , 64 , 37 , 70 , 63 , 38 ) (67,66,3,68,65,36,69,64,37,70,63,38) .
Its entries specify the virtual wire used by each logical qubit; both lists use zero-based indices.

paragraphs.en: The final comparison used eight further HEP18 test observations. None was used for layout selection or the intermediate confirmation. For each observation, we ran the original, selected and reflected layouts with 1,024 shots each. We rotated submission order across observations, completing and saving each job before submitting the next.
paragraphs.zh: 最终比较使用了另外八个 HEP18 测试观测。 这些观测均未用于布局选择或中间确认。 对于每个观测，我们分别以 1,024 次采样运行原始布局、选定布局和反射布局。 我们在各观测之间轮换提交顺序，并在提交下一个任务之前完成并保存每个任务。

sents.en: The final comparison used eight further HEP18 test observations.
sents.zh: 最终比较使用了另外八个 HEP18 测试观测。

sents.en: None was used for layout selection or the intermediate confirmation.
sents.zh: 这些观测均未用于布局选择或中间确认。

sents.en: For each observation, we ran the original, selected and reflected layouts with 1,024 shots each.
sents.zh: 对于每个观测，我们分别以 1,024 次采样运行原始布局、选定布局和反射布局。

sents.en: We rotated submission order across observations, completing and saving each job before submitting the next.
sents.zh: 我们在各观测之间轮换提交顺序，并在提交下一个任务之前完成并保存每个任务。

paragraphs.en: Twelve binary-index basis preparations verified bit order across the three layouts. These controls prepare known patterns of zeros and ones, so returned bits can be matched to their intended logical positions. Six final all-zero/all-one controls completed the 42-job protocol. We used no readout correction, dynamical decoupling, sample rejection or model updates. Every measured code entered the same frozen prediction pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 十二个二进制索引基准准备工作验证了三种布局下的比特顺序。 这些对照准备已知的零和一模式，因此返回的比特可以与其预期的逻辑位置进行匹配。 六个最终的全零/全一对照完成了42个任务的协议。 我们没有使用读出校正、动力学解耦、样本剔除或模型更新。 每一个测量的编码都进入了同一个冻结的预测流水线。

sents.en: Twelve binary-index basis preparations verified bit order across the three layouts.
sents.zh: 十二个二进制索引基准准备工作验证了三种布局下的比特顺序。

sents.en: These controls prepare known patterns of zeros and ones, so returned bits can be matched to their intended logical positions.
sents.zh: 这些对照准备已知的零和一模式，因此返回的比特可以与其预期的逻辑位置进行匹配。

sents.en: Six final all-zero/all-one controls completed the 42-job protocol.
sents.zh: 六个最终的全零/全一对照完成了42个任务的协议。

sents.en: We used no readout correction, dynamical decoupling, sample rejection or model updates.
sents.zh: 我们没有使用读出校正、动力学解耦、样本剔除或模型更新。

sents.en: Every measured code entered the same frozen prediction pipeline.
sents.zh: 每一个测量的编码都进入了同一个冻结的预测流水线。

paragraphs.en: For each observation and layout, we divide the 1,024 shots into eight disjoint groups of 128. We compute metrics within each group, then average over all groups and observations in Table 15 . The ideal reference uses the same observations, grouping and sample budget. Thus each metric evaluation retains the 128-draw budget used in the main experiments. All evaluations use the position and speed tolerances in Appendix F.4 . The repeated groups characterize sampling from one checkpoint, not variation across independently trained models.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个观测和布局，我们将 1,024 次采样划分为八个互不重叠的组，每组 128 次。 我们在每个组内计算指标，然后在表 15 中对所有组和观测取平均。 理想参考使用相同的观测、分组和采样预算。 因此每次指标评估都保留主实验中使用的 128 次采样预算。 所有评估均使用附录 F.4 中的位置和速度容差。 重复分组刻画的是来自同一检查点的采样情况，而非独立训练的模型之间的差异。

sents.en: For each observation and layout, we divide the 1,024 shots into eight disjoint groups of 128.
sents.zh: 对于每个观测和布局，我们将 1,024 次采样划分为八个互不重叠的组，每组 128 次。

sents.en: We compute metrics within each group, then average over all groups and observations in Table 15 .
sents.zh: 我们在每个组内计算指标，然后在表 15 中对所有组和观测取平均。

sents.en: The ideal reference uses the same observations, grouping and sample budget.
sents.zh: 理想参考使用相同的观测、分组和采样预算。

sents.en: Thus each metric evaluation retains the 128-draw budget used in the main experiments.
sents.zh: 因此每次指标评估都保留主实验中使用的 128 次采样预算。

sents.en: All evaluations use the position and speed tolerances in Appendix F.4 .
sents.zh: 所有评估均使用附录 F.4 中的位置和速度容差。

sents.en: The repeated groups characterize sampling from one checkpoint, not variation across independently trained models.
sents.zh: 重复分组刻画的是来自同一检查点的采样情况，而非独立训练的模型之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: The reflected layout increased validity by 9.81 percentage points relative to the original layout. It also reduced joint TV for each of the eight observations. Its joint validity reached 86.69%, compared with 98.41% under ideal sampling. All individual-agent continuations remained locally valid, but 13.31% of joint samples combined local actions that were incompatible with the same priority choice. Independently re-pairing agents reduced validity to 12.95%. The original measured samples therefore retained substantial cross-agent coordination despite the remaining hardware errors.
paragraphs.zh: 反思后的布局相比原始布局将有效率提升了9.81个百分点。 它还降低了八个观测中每一个的联合TV。 其联合有效率达到了86.69%，而理想采样下为98.41%。 所有单个智能体的延续在局部均保持有效，但13.31%的联合样本组合了与相同优先级选择不相容的局部动作。 独立地重新配对智能体使有效率降至12.95%。 因此，原始测量样本尽管存在残余的硬件错误，仍保留了可观的跨智能体协调性。

sents.en: The reflected layout increased validity by 9.81 percentage points relative to the original layout.
sents.zh: 反思后的布局相比原始布局将有效率提升了9.81个百分点。

sents.en: It also reduced joint TV for each of the eight observations.
sents.zh: 它还降低了八个观测中每一个的联合TV。

sents.en: Its joint validity reached 86.69%, compared with 98.41% under ideal sampling.
sents.zh: 其联合有效率达到了86.69%，而理想采样下为98.41%。

sents.en: All individual-agent continuations remained locally valid, but 13.31% of joint samples combined local actions that were incompatible with the same priority choice.
sents.zh: 所有单个智能体的延续在局部均保持有效，但13.31%的联合样本组合了与相同优先级选择不相容的局部动作。

sents.en: Independently re-pairing agents reduced validity to 12.95%.
sents.zh: 独立地重新配对智能体使有效率降至12.95%。

sents.en: The original measured samples therefore retained substantial cross-agent coordination despite the remaining hardware errors.
sents.zh: 因此，原始测量样本尽管存在残余的硬件错误，仍保留了可观的跨智能体协调性。

paragraphs.en: Using only the first group of 128 shots gave validity of 75.00%, 81.35% and 83.59% for the original, selected and reflected layouts. The headline averages retain every group, rather than selecting the most favourable one. This is a matched comparison of layouts on one device; it does not measure robustness across different days.
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用第一组 128 次射击时，原始、筛选和镜像布局的有效性分别为 75.00%、81.35% 和 83.59%。 标题中的平均值保留了每一个组，而不是只挑选最有利的那一组。 这是在同一台设备上对各布局进行的匹配比较，并不能衡量在不同日期下的稳健性。

sents.en: Using only the first group of 128 shots gave validity of 75.00%, 81.35% and 83.59% for the original, selected and reflected layouts.
sents.zh: 仅使用第一组 128 次射击时，原始、筛选和镜像布局的有效性分别为 75.00%、81.35% 和 83.59%。

sents.en: The headline averages retain every group, rather than selecting the most favourable one.
sents.zh: 标题中的平均值保留了每一个组，而不是只挑选最有利的那一组。

sents.en: This is a matched comparison of layouts on one device; it does not measure robustness across different days.
sents.zh: 这是在同一台设备上对各布局进行的匹配比较，并不能衡量在不同日期下的稳健性。

paragraphs.en: We also tested readout bit-flip averaging and equivalent changes to the circuit’s phase frame. Further tests split rotations into half-angle gates or executed CZ gates sequentially instead of concurrently. These alternatives did not consistently improve development results and were omitted from the final setup. An earlier confirmation batch was interrupted because some cloud-task records became unavailable. We retained that batch separately and did not combine it with the complete final comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还测试了读出比特翻转平均以及对线路相位参考系的等效更改。 进一步的测试将旋转门拆分为半角度门，或者改为顺序执行 CZ 门而非并行执行。 这些替代方案并未能持续改进开发结果，因此未纳入最终设置。 由于部分云端任务记录变得不可用，较早的一批确认实验被中断。 我们单独保留了该批次的数据，未将其与完整的最终比较合并。

sents.en: We also tested readout bit-flip averaging and equivalent changes to the circuit’s phase frame.
sents.zh: 我们还测试了读出比特翻转平均以及对线路相位参考系的等效更改。

sents.en: Further tests split rotations into half-angle gates or executed CZ gates sequentially instead of concurrently.
sents.zh: 进一步的测试将旋转门拆分为半角度门，或者改为顺序执行 CZ 门而非并行执行。

sents.en: These alternatives did not consistently improve development results and were omitted from the final setup.
sents.zh: 这些替代方案并未能持续改进开发结果，因此未纳入最终设置。

sents.en: An earlier confirmation batch was interrupted because some cloud-task records became unavailable.
sents.zh: 由于部分云端任务记录变得不可用，较早的一批确认实验被中断。

sents.en: We retained that batch separately and did not combine it with the complete final comparison.
sents.zh: 我们单独保留了该批次的数据，未将其与完整的最终比较合并。

paragraphs.en: We deployed the eight-qubit Product-QCBM and Entangled-QCBM checkpoints from the first fold and training run of Table 4 . Both were trained with noisy parameter shift and kept fixed during deployment. Each prior generated 40 raw rollouts from the common stationary point using the re-encoding and stopping rules in Appendix B.4 . Every latent action came from a fresh QPU measurement, including after re-encoding a predicted segment. The neural networks ran on the GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 我们部署了表 4 第一次折与第一次训练运行所得的八量子比特 Product-QCBM 与 Entangled-QCBM 检查点。 两者均使用含噪参数移位进行训练，并在部署期间保持固定。 每个先验使用附录 B.4 中的重编码与停止规则，从公共平稳点生成 40 条原始轨迹。 每个潜在动作均来自一次全新的 QPU 测量，包括对预测片段进行重编码之后亦如此。 神经网络在 GPU 上运行。

sents.en: We deployed the eight-qubit Product-QCBM and Entangled-QCBM checkpoints from the first fold and training run of Table 4 .
sents.zh: 我们部署了表 4 第一次折与第一次训练运行所得的八量子比特 Product-QCBM 与 Entangled-QCBM 检查点。

sents.en: Both were trained with noisy parameter shift and kept fixed during deployment.
sents.zh: 两者均使用含噪参数移位进行训练，并在部署期间保持固定。

sents.en: Each prior generated 40 raw rollouts from the common stationary point using the re-encoding and stopping rules in Appendix B.4 .
sents.zh: 每个先验使用附录 B.4 中的重编码与停止规则，从公共平稳点生成 40 条原始轨迹。

sents.en: Every latent action came from a fresh QPU measurement, including after re-encoding a predicted segment.
sents.zh: 每个潜在动作均来自一次全新的 QPU 测量，包括对预测片段进行重编码之后亦如此。

sents.en: The neural networks ran on the GPU.
sents.zh: 神经网络在 GPU 上运行。

paragraphs.en: We used an eight-qubit chain on AGate-100, selected from device calibration without target trajectories or predictive scores. CNOT-to-CZ compilation and single-qubit gate fusion gave eight local gate blocks for Product-QCBM, and 36 local blocks plus 14 CZs for Entangled-QCBM. Noiseless compilation checks preserved Born probabilities to within 4.22 × 10 − 15 4.22\times 10^{-15} for both circuits. Four known basis patterns, each measured with 128 shots, verified bit order. Identical circuits within a recursive step shared a submission, with a separate measurement shot for each path. We used raw measurements without readout correction, dynamical decoupling or additional simulated noise. Product-QCBM and Entangled-QCBM supplied 458 and 437 latent actions, respectively. Together with the controls, this required 775 tasks and 1,407 measurement shots. We checked returned instructions, mappings and shot counts, and replayed the saved measurements to reproduce all 80 paths exactly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 AGate-100 上选取了一条由设备校准得到的八量子比特链，未使用目标轨迹或预测分数。 CNOT 到 CZ 的编译以及单量子比特门融合为 Product-QCBM 生成了 8 个局部门块，为 Entangled-QCBM 生成了 36 个局部块和 14 个 CZ 门。 无噪声编译验证表明，两个线路的 Born 概率保持误差在 4.22 × 10 − 15 4.22\times 10^{-15} 以内。 通过对四个已知基底模式各进行 128 次测量，验证了比特顺序。 同一递归步骤内的相同线路共享一次提交，每条路径单独进行一次测量采样。 我们使用未经读出校正、动力学解耦或额外模拟噪声的原始测量结果。 Product-QCBM 和 Entangled-QCBM 分别提供了 458 个和 437 个潜在动作。 加上对照组，这共需要 775 个任务和 1,407 次测量采样。 我们检查了返回的指令、映射和采样次数，并重放了保存的测量结果，精确复现了全部 80 条路径。

sents.en: We used an eight-qubit chain on AGate-100, selected from device calibration without target trajectories or predictive scores.
sents.zh: 我们在 AGate-100 上选取了一条由设备校准得到的八量子比特链，未使用目标轨迹或预测分数。

sents.en: CNOT-to-CZ compilation and single-qubit gate fusion gave eight local gate blocks for Product-QCBM, and 36 local blocks plus 14 CZs for Entangled-QCBM.
sents.zh: CNOT 到 CZ 的编译以及单量子比特门融合为 Product-QCBM 生成了 8 个局部门块，为 Entangled-QCBM 生成了 36 个局部块和 14 个 CZ 门。

sents.en: Noiseless compilation checks preserved Born probabilities to within 4.22 × 10 − 15 4.22\times 10^{-15} for both circuits.
sents.zh: 无噪声编译验证表明，两个线路的 Born 概率保持误差在 4.22 × 10 − 15 4.22\times 10^{-15} 以内。

sents.en: Four known basis patterns, each measured with 128 shots, verified bit order.
sents.zh: 通过对四个已知基底模式各进行 128 次测量，验证了比特顺序。

sents.en: Identical circuits within a recursive step shared a submission, with a separate measurement shot for each path.
sents.zh: 同一递归步骤内的相同线路共享一次提交，每条路径单独进行一次测量采样。

sents.en: We used raw measurements without readout correction, dynamical decoupling or additional simulated noise.
sents.zh: 我们使用未经读出校正、动力学解耦或额外模拟噪声的原始测量结果。

sents.en: Product-QCBM and Entangled-QCBM supplied 458 and 437 latent actions, respectively.
sents.zh: Product-QCBM 和 Entangled-QCBM 分别提供了 458 个和 437 个潜在动作。

sents.en: Together with the controls, this required 775 tasks and 1,407 measurement shots.
sents.zh: 加上对照组，这共需要 775 个任务和 1,407 次测量采样。

sents.en: We checked returned instructions, mappings and shot counts, and replayed the saved measurements to reproduce all 80 paths exactly.
sents.zh: 我们检查了返回的指令、映射和采样次数，并重放了保存的测量结果，精确复现了全部 80 条路径。

paragraphs.en: We use the same geometric checks, route definitions and uniform 24-route reference as in Table 4 . That table summarizes nine models per method, each evaluated with 384 raw rollouts, and reports expected metrics for a subset of 60 accepted paths. The hardware check uses one checkpoint per prior and 40 raw rollouts, because each recursive step requires a new conditional circuit execution. Both accepted pools are smaller than the 60-path budget of the main comparison. We therefore report the routes and TV of each complete accepted pool. The route count C C corresponds to coverage C / 24 C/24 . Coverage and TV depend on sample count, so we compare hardware results with GPU sampling at the same budget.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用与表4中相同的几何检查、路由定义以及统一的24条路由参考集。 该表总结了每种方法的九个模型，每个模型通过384次原始 rollout 进行评估，并报告了60条已接受路径子集的期望指标。 硬件检查对每个先验使用一个检查点和40次原始 rollout，因为每个递归步骤都需要一次新的条件电路执行。 两个已接受的路径池都小于主比较中的60条路径预算。 因此我们报告每个完整已接受路径池的路由和 TV。 路由数 C 对应于覆盖率 C/24。 覆盖率和 TV 依赖于样本数量，因此我们将硬件结果与相同预算下的 GPU 采样进行比较。

sents.en: We use the same geometric checks, route definitions and uniform 24-route reference as in Table 4 .
sents.zh: 我们使用与表4中相同的几何检查、路由定义以及统一的24条路由参考集。

sents.en: That table summarizes nine models per method, each evaluated with 384 raw rollouts, and reports expected metrics for a subset of 60 accepted paths.
sents.zh: 该表总结了每种方法的九个模型，每个模型通过384次原始 rollout 进行评估，并报告了60条已接受路径子集的期望指标。

sents.en: The hardware check uses one checkpoint per prior and 40 raw rollouts, because each recursive step requires a new conditional circuit execution.
sents.zh: 硬件检查对每个先验使用一个检查点和40次原始 rollout，因为每个递归步骤都需要一次新的条件电路执行。

sents.en: Both accepted pools are smaller than the 60-path budget of the main comparison.
sents.zh: 两个已接受的路径池都小于主比较中的60条路径预算。

sents.en: We therefore report the routes and TV of each complete accepted pool.
sents.zh: 因此我们报告每个完整已接受路径池的路由和 TV。

sents.en: The route count C C corresponds to coverage C / 24 C/24 .
sents.zh: 路由数 C 对应于覆盖率 C/24。

sents.en: Coverage and TV depend on sample count, so we compare hardware results with GPU sampling at the same budget.
sents.zh: 覆盖率和 TV 依赖于样本数量，因此我们将硬件结果与相同预算下的 GPU 采样进行比较。

paragraphs.en: For each fixed checkpoint, we ran 20 GPU sampling repetitions with the same budget of 40 raw paths. We tested both noiseless sampling and sampling with 0.5% readout flips. Each hardware row in Table 16 reports one run; GPU standard deviations measure variation across the sampling repetitions.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个固定检查点，我们以相同的40条原始路径预算运行了20次GPU采样重复实验。 我们测试了无噪声采样以及带有0.5%读出翻转的采样。 表16中每一行硬件结果对应一次运行；GPU标准差衡量的是各采样重复之间的波动。

sents.en: For each fixed checkpoint, we ran 20 GPU sampling repetitions with the same budget of 40 raw paths.
sents.zh: 对于每个固定检查点，我们以相同的40条原始路径预算运行了20次GPU采样重复实验。

sents.en: We tested both noiseless sampling and sampling with 0.5% readout flips.
sents.zh: 我们测试了无噪声采样以及带有0.5%读出翻转的采样。

sents.en: Each hardware row in Table 16 reports one run; GPU standard deviations measure variation across the sampling repetitions.

paragraphs.en: Product-QCBM produced 13 accepted paths spanning 10 routes; Entangled-QCBM produced 17 spanning 13 routes. The noisy GPU references covered 5–13 and 6–14 routes, respectively. Hardware coverage falls within these ranges, showing that the trained priors can support complete recursive prediction on a QPU.

paragraphs.en: We also compare the expected number of routes in a uniform eight-path subset of each accepted pool ( Table 17 ). Pools with fewer than eight accepted paths are omitted only from this supplementary statistic; their counts appear in the caption. The hardware values are 6.92 and 7.05 routes, close after matching the number of accepted paths.
